Welcome to the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra

A home away from home — celebrating culture, heritage, and community since 1964

We're more than a club — we're a community, a home away from home where Slovenian heritage meets Australian spirit. Whether you're here to connect with friends, celebrate Slovenian traditions, or simply explore a vibrant culture, you'll find a place that welcomes everyone with open arms.

Founded in 1964 by a small but passionate group of Slovenian families, our club has grown into one of Canberra's most beloved cultural communities. Our iconic Triglav-inspired clubhouse in Phillip stands as a proud symbol of our resilience and connection to our homeland.

Our Story: A Legacy of Culture, Unity & Growth

The Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra is more than a club — it's a living tribute to the vibrant spirit, heritage, and enduring unity of our Slovenian community. Founded in 1964 by a small but passionate group of Slovenian families and young adults, the club quickly became a cherished gathering space and cultural touchstone.

In 1971, after years of volunteer efforts and heartfelt fundraising, their dreams took shape in a unique architectural masterpiece. Designed to evoke the silhouette of Mount Triglav, Slovenia's tallest and most beloved peak, our clubhouse stands proudly in Canberra's Woden district — symbolising the resilience and strength of our community.

The Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra isn't just preserving a legacy — it's building one that will inspire, unite, and celebrate generations to come.

Home / Welcome

Welcome to the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra!

A home away from home

We're more than a club — a community, a home away from home where Slovenian heritage meets Australian spirit.

Welcome to the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra! Whether you're here to connect with friends, celebrate Slovenian traditions, or simply explore a vibrant culture, you'll find a place that welcomes everyone with open arms.

Our club is built on the values of inclusivity, respect, and connection. We come together to honour our roots, support one another, and celebrate everything that makes our Slovenian-Australian community special. Our gathering spaces, filled with warmth and character, offer a welcoming environment for cultural events, social gatherings, family-friendly activities, and volunteer opportunities.

Join us as we preserve the rich traditions of Slovenia and embrace the best of Australian life. Together, we're building memories, fostering friendships, and creating a legacy for generations to come. Welcome to the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra – where every member is part of the family!

Meet Our Committee

The heart and soul of the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra

PRESIDENT & SECRETARY

Natasha Kapušin

At the helm of the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, Natasha Kapušin is nothing short of a force of nature — a powerhouse of passion, vision, determination and integrity. Driven by a profound love of Slovenian and Australian cultures, she is a passionate champion of the community and its future.

As President and Secretary, Natasha is a driving force behind the Club’s growth and development. She has helped secure valuable funding, deliver major projects, strengthen government, community and Slovenian connections, and modernise the Club, while creating a welcoming environment where people of all generations and backgrounds can come together.

A passionate custodian of Slovenian heritage, Natasha is revitalising traditions and bringing them back to life — from Slovenian language learning and folk dancing to traditional music, food, costumes, celebrations and cultural events. She is helping younger generations reconnect with their heritage while sharing Slovenian culture with the wider Australian community.

Her commitment extends well beyond her official roles, with hands-on involvement in fundraising, events, facilities, communications, partnerships and bringing volunteers together. She has a remarkable ability to turn ideas into action and challenges into opportunities.

Through her leadership, the Club continues to honour its history while building a vibrant future — keeping Slovenian culture relevant, visible and proudly alive in Canberra.

🏆 Awards & Recognition

Natasha was recognised with the Slovenian Community Leadership Award (2024/25), presented in 2026 at Club Triglav Mounties, acknowledging her leadership and contribution to the Slovenian community.

In 2024 and 2025, she received a Certificate of Recognition for her contribution to the local community and tireless volunteer work, presented by David Smith MP at Parliament House, Canberra.

Under her leadership, the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra was also honoured with the Canberra Gold Award in 2025, recognising more than 50 years of contribution to Canberra’s multicultural community.

The Association was also presented with a Certificate of Appreciation in 2026 in recognition of its support of the 2026 Kidney Kar Rally, acknowledging the Club’s contribution to this community initiative.

Na čelu Slovensko-avstralskega združenja Canberra stoji Nataša Kapušin — prava naravna sila, poosebljenje strasti, vizije, odločnosti in integritete. Vodi jo globoka ljubezen do slovenske in avstralske kulture, zato je predana zagovornica naše skupnosti in njene prihodnosti.

Kot predsednica in tajnica je Nataša gonilna sila rasti in razvoja kluba. Pomagala je pridobiti dragocena sredstva, izpeljati velike projekte, okrepiti vezi z vladnimi ustanovami, skupnostjo in Slovenijo ter posodobiti klub, hkrati pa ustvarja prijazno okolje, v katerem se lahko srečujejo ljudje vseh generacij in ozadij.

Kot predana varuhinja slovenske dediščine Nataša oživlja tradicije in jim vdihuje novo življenje — od učenja slovenskega jezika in ljudskih plesov do tradicionalne glasbe, hrane, narodnih noš, praznovanj in kulturnih prireditev. Mlajšim generacijam pomaga, da se znova povežejo s svojimi koreninami, obenem pa slovensko kulturo predstavlja širši avstralski skupnosti.

Njena predanost sega daleč onkraj uradnih vlog: dejavno sodeluje pri zbiranju sredstev, prireditvah, skrbi za prostore, komunikaciji, partnerstvih in povezovanju prostovoljcev. Ima izjemen dar, da zamisli spremeni v dejanja, izzive pa v priložnosti.

Pod njenim vodstvom klub še naprej spoštuje svojo zgodovino in hkrati gradi živahno prihodnost — tako da slovenska kultura v Canberri ostaja aktualna, vidna in ponosno živa.

🏆 Nagrade in priznanja

Nataša je prejela priznanje Slovenian Community Leadership Award (2024/25), podeljeno leta 2026 v klubu Triglav Mounties, kot priznanje za njeno vodenje in prispevek k slovenski skupnosti.

V letih 2024 in 2025 je prejela priznanje (Certificate of Recognition) za prispevek k lokalni skupnosti in neutrudno prostovoljno delo, ki ji ga je v parlamentu v Canberri podelil poslanec David Smith.

Pod njenim vodstvom je Slovensko-avstralsko združenje Canberra leta 2025 prejelo tudi nagrado Canberra Gold Award za več kot 50 let prispevka k multikulturni skupnosti Canberre.

Združenje je leta 2026 prejelo tudi zahvalo (Certificate of Appreciation) za podporo reliju Kidney Kar Rally 2026, s čimer je bil priznan prispevek kluba k tej dobrodelni pobudi skupnosti.

Maintenance Manager & Public Officer

Fred is the driving force behind the upkeep, refurbishment and improvement of our club's facilities. His hands-on expertise and commitment have been instrumental in transforming our club, from refurbishing the clubhouse and bocce hall to revitalising the outdoor areas. He has guided major improvements including the kitchen and bathroom redevelopment, new fireplace installation and ongoing infrastructure works. 🏆 In 2025, Fred received a Certificate of Recognition for his contribution to the local community and tireless volunteer work, presented by David Smith MP at Parliament House, Canberra. Committee Members

Daryl Whitfeld • Bella Hall • Deb Nimmo • Grahame Nimmo

Working quietly behind the scenes, our Committee Members are the backbone of our Association.

They are the people who step forward when something needs to be done, often without recognition or fanfare. Bringing together years of experience, practical knowledge, fresh ideas and a genuine commitment to our community, they support the Executive Team and contribute wherever they are needed.

From helping introduce new systems and supporting events, to working behind the bar, joining working bees, solving problems and contributing to the future direction of the club, their work is felt across every part of the Association.

Their dedication, reliability and willingness to simply roll up their sleeves and get involved are what help turn plans into reality. They are an essential part of the team that keeps our club moving forward — strengthening our community, supporting our volunteers and helping preserve the Slovenian spirit and traditions that have been at the heart of our Association for more than six decades.

They may work behind the scenes, but their contribution is at the heart of everything we do.

Člani odbora, ki tiho delujejo v ozadju, so hrbtenica našega združenja.

To so ljudje, ki stopijo naprej, ko je treba kaj postoriti, pogosto brez priznanj in pompa. Združujejo dolgoletne izkušnje, praktično znanje, sveže zamisli in iskreno predanost naši skupnosti; podpirajo izvršilno ekipo in prispevajo povsod, kjer jih potrebujemo.

Od uvajanja novih sistemov in podpore prireditvam do dela za točilnim pultom, delovnih akcij, reševanja težav in soustvarjanja prihodnje smeri kluba — njihovo delo je čutiti v vsakem delu združenja.

Njihova predanost, zanesljivost in pripravljenost, da preprosto zavihajo rokave in se vključijo, so tisto, kar pomaga spremeniti načrte v resničnost. So bistven del ekipe, ki naš klub vodi naprej — krepi našo skupnost, podpira naše prostovoljce in pomaga ohranjati slovenskega duha in tradicije, ki so več kot šest desetletij v srcu našega združenja.

Morda delujejo v ozadju, a njihov prispevek je v središču vsega, kar počnemo.

Our Story

A legacy of culture, unity, and growth

Our Story: A Legacy of Culture, Unity, and Growth

The Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra is more than a club — it's a living tribute to the vibrant spirit, heritage, and enduring unity of our Slovenian community. Founded in 1964 by a small but passionate group of Slovenian families and young adults, the club quickly became a cherished gathering space and cultural touchstone. In 1971, after years of volunteer efforts and heartfelt fundraising, their dreams took shape in a unique architectural masterpiece. Designed to evoke the silhouette of Mount Triglav, Slovenia's tallest and most beloved peak, our clubhouse stands proudly in Canberra's Woden district, symbolising the resilience and strength of our community and our connection to the Slovenian homeland.

Once a thriving hub of activity and camaraderie, the club has experienced fluctuations over the years, but our community remains resilient and determined to restore the vibrancy of our beloved association. Our story reflects generations of Slovenians and Australians who come together to celebrate and preserve a rich heritage. From the very beginning, the club was a space for sharing traditional Slovenian cuisine, language, music, and dance, cultivating a deep connection across generations. Over the years, celebrations of Statehood Day, Prešeren Day, and other cultural events have enriched our calendar alongside regular Friday and Sunday gatherings. Each occasion offers members of all ages the chance to experience Slovenian culture in a welcoming, joyful environment where lively performances, music, and festivities bring both Slovenians and Australians together in celebration.

Beyond social events, our club offers members a carefully curated library filled with Slovenian literature, a cherished resource that keeps our language and culture alive. More than a community space, the association has also championed causes close to the Slovenian heart. During Slovenia's fight for independence in the early 1990s, our members took a stand, advocating for our homeland within Australia and helping to strengthen cultural ties.

Today, our association continues to grow and adapt, creating an inclusive environment for all members. New projects aimed at accessibility, expanded amenities, and exciting programs reflect our ongoing commitment to reviving the lively atmosphere that once defined our club. Each addition and event celebrates the Slovenian way of life, ensuring our traditions continue to thrive in Canberra's multicultural landscape.

The Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra isn't just preserving a legacy — it's building one that will inspire, unite, and celebrate generations to come.

A Piece of Our History

In 1991, members of the Australian Slovenian community gathered outside Parliament House in Canberra, flags raised, calling for Australia's recognition of an independent Slovenia. This framed photograph, donated to the Slovenian Embassy in Canberra by Lojz Papež, now hangs proudly in our club.

Home / Our Story / Triglav — Our Inspiration

Triglav: The Heart, Soul, and Legacy of Our Community

Why our club roof emulates Slovenia's most beloved peak

2,864 METRES OF INSPIRATION
OUR CLUBHOUSE ROOF — INSPIRED BY MOUNT TRIGLAV

Standing proudly in Canberra, our clubhouse roof is inspired by the distinctive silhouette of Mount Triglav — Slovenia's highest mountain at 2,864 metres.

A little piece of Slovenia, right here in Canberra.

🏔️
Triglav
2,864 metres · Slovenia's highest peak · National symbol · On the Slovenian flag and coat of arms

Triglav, the towering symbol of Slovenia, represents far more than just a majestic peak — its spirit embodies resilience, unity, and heritage that transcend borders. As the tallest mountain in Slovenia, Triglav holds a sacred place in the hearts of Slovenians, and it has found a lasting home in our club here in Canberra.

Our club's roof, inspired by the architectural magnificence of Triglav, is a tribute not just to the physical mountain but to the enduring values it represents. It serves as a beacon of strength, a symbol of the deep connection between Slovenia and Australia, and a reminder of the courage and pride that runs through our veins. Much like Triglav, our club stands tall — a place where the bonds of community are built, cherished, and passed down through generations.

The essence of Triglav runs through every part of our club's soul. It is more than just a physical structure — it is the spirit of our members, the collective heartbeat of all those who carry forward the rich legacy of Slovenian culture and tradition. Our community reflects the timeless values of Triglav: unity, resilience, and pride in the heritage that binds us all.

Triglav represents not only the physical, towering presence of Slovenia but the strength and unyielding nature of our own community here in Canberra. It is a testament to the legacy of our ancestors who first carried the spirit of Triglav across the world, and a lasting symbol for those who continue to build upon that legacy. Just as the mountain stands steadfast through the ages, our club remains a vibrant and unwavering part of the fabric of Canberra, united by a common purpose.

We invite you to join us in this extraordinary journey. Be part of a community that embodies the heart and soul of Slovenia, that lives the legacy of Triglav every day, and that shapes the future with passion and purpose.

Home / Naša Miza

Naša Miza

The Slovenian Australian Cookbook

📖
Every Recipe Tells a Story.
Every Story Brings Us Home.
Submissions Open

The Secret Ingredient Is Always Love.

Do you have a treasured family recipe that's been passed down through generations? Perhaps it's your grandmother's potica, your father's favourite Sunday lunch, or a dish that has become part of your own family's traditions.

We're inviting Slovenian Australians from every state and territory to help create something truly special — a cookbook that celebrates our food, our families, and the stories that have travelled from Slovenia to Australia.

Whether your family arrived generations ago or more recently, your recipes are part of our shared heritage. Together, we'll create a beautiful keepsake that preserves the flavours, traditions and memories of our community for generations to come.

We'd love you to share:

🍲
A favourite family recipeThe dish that brings everyone to the table
✍️
A short story about the recipeWho made it, when it was enjoyed, or why it holds a special place in your family
📸
A photoThe finished dish, your family, a treasured handwritten recipe card, or a special memory connected to your story
🗺️

Our dream is to include recipes and stories from every Australian state and territory, showcasing the incredible diversity of the Slovenian Australian community from coast to coast.

🤫

One small favour...

We all know that Slovenian families are famous for having a "secret ingredient" that somehow never makes it onto the recipe card! This time, we're asking you to include the secret ingredient too so everyone can recreate your family favourite exactly as it was meant to be. After all, we want every recipe in Naša Miza to work perfectly!

Help us fill these pages with the recipes that brought families together around the table, the stories that made us laugh, and the traditions that remind us where we came from.

Share your recipe. Share your story.

Help us create a cookbook that every Slovenian Australian family will be proud to call their own.

Because every recipe tells a story... and the secret ingredient is always love.

Submit Your Recipe

Share your family recipe and story with us — we'd love to include it in Naša Miza

If you have a photo of the dish, your family, or a handwritten recipe card, please email it directly to secretary@slovenianclubcanberra.org.au with the subject line Naša Miza Photo.

Every submission is read by Natasha personally. Thank you for helping us create this special keepsake.

Become a Volunteer

Be part of something bigger at the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra

🤝
Join Our Volunteer Team
Become a Part of Something Bigger – Join Our Volunteer Team at the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra!

At the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, we believe in the power of community to inspire and transform. Whether you're Australian or Slovenian, we invite you to take an active role in shaping the future of our vibrant club. Volunteering here means more than just lending a hand – it's about becoming part of a welcoming family that values connection, culture, and the strength of collective effort.

For our Slovenian members, volunteering offers the unique opportunity to honor the legacy of their fathers, grandparents, and great-grandparents, who founded and built this club through their tireless dedication. Imagine the pride of continuing this tradition of hard work and service, ensuring that their efforts are carried forward for generations to come.

Why Volunteer With Us?

Volunteering with us is not just about giving your time – it's about being part of a warm, welcoming family where your contributions make a real impact. You'll have the chance to connect with like-minded individuals, develop new skills, and contribute to the preservation of Slovenian culture in Canberra. Plus, volunteering is a great way to feel uplifted and energized while working together to create an inclusive and vibrant environment for our community.

How Can You Get Involved?

It's simple! Just reach out to us and let us know where you'd like to contribute. We believe every hand helps, and whether you have a few hours to spare or are looking for ongoing involvement, there's a place for you with us.

Become Part of Our Family!

Volunteering is not just about tasks – it's about building connections, making lasting memories, and being part of something bigger. At the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, we work together to create a positive impact, and we'd love for you to be a part of it.

Join us today and make a difference in our community, honoring the legacy of those who came before us!

For Food Lovers – A Culinary Journey Awaits!

Explore the History, Culture & Festivals of Slovenia

Slovenia has a history rich in tradition, and its festivals are the heartbeat of its culture. Learn more about the country's past, its national festivals, and the cultural events that shape Slovenian identity. Discover the unique customs that make Slovenia one of Europe's most fascinating countries to explore.

I Feel Slovenia — Official Tourism ↗  ·  Culture of Slovenia — Wikipedia ↗  ·  Republic of Slovenia — Official Site ↗

🇸🇮

No Passport Required to Discover Slovenian Culture

Join us as we celebrate the heritage, beauty, and traditions of Slovenia. Whether you're exploring historic sites, indulging in culinary delights, or learning the language — there's a whole world to discover!

🏔️

Slovenia's Historic Landmarks & Majestic Views

Explore Slovenia's legendary landmarks — must-see sites that showcase its rich history and natural beauty.

🏰

Ljubljana Castle

Towering over the capital, Ljubljana Castle is a symbol of Slovenia's history, offering panoramic views of the city and rich cultural exhibits.

Explore Ljubljana Castle ↗
🏞️

Lake Bled

A stunning alpine lake with a picturesque island church and castle — one of Slovenia's most iconic spots, perfect for nature lovers and history buffs.

Discover Lake Bled ↗
⛰️

Velika Planina

One of the largest mountain pastures in the Alps — a highland plateau dotted with traditional herders' huts (koče) and grazing cattle, reached by cable car above Kamnik.

Discover Velika Planina ↗
🌊

Piran

A jewel on the Adriatic — Piran is Slovenia's enchanting coastal town with Venetian architecture, winding medieval streets, and stunning sea views.

Discover Piran ↗
💚

Tolminski Lom

Tolminski Lom is one of the Soča Valley's most dramatic gorges — a wild stretch of turquoise water carved through rock near Tolmin, framed by waterfalls and forest.

Explore Tolminski Lom ↗
🏔️

Triglav Mountain

At 2,864 metres, Triglav is Slovenia's highest peak and its most powerful national symbol — featured on the flag and the coat of arms. A challenge and a pilgrimage.

About Triglav ↗
🪷

Bohinj

Slovenia's largest glacial lake, nestled in the Triglav National Park — wilder and more tranquil than Bled, surrounded by breathtaking mountains and forests.

Discover Bohinj ↗
🍇

Stara Trta, Maribor

The oldest vine in the world — over 400 years old and still bearing fruit in the heart of Maribor. A living symbol of Slovenian wine culture and resilience.

Visit Stara Trta ↗
🌿

Logarska Dolina

One of the most beautiful alpine valleys in Europe — a pristine glacial valley in the Kamnik-Savinja Alps, with cascading waterfalls and meadows of wildflowers.

Explore Logarska Dolina ↗

Home / Members / Our Members Library

Our Members Library

A little piece of Slovenia. A place to relax, connect and enjoy.

Step inside, slow down and make yourself at home. Our Members Library is a cosy space where you can settle into a comfortable chair beside the fire, enjoy a Slovenian book, catch up with friends or simply take some time for yourself.

Bring a friend and challenge them to a game of chess, backgammon, checkers, Jenga or cards, with plenty of other games to discover and enjoy.

Whether you’re reconnecting with Slovenian stories and traditions, sharing a laugh over a game, or enjoying a quiet moment by the fire, the library is a welcoming space for members of all generations.

Grab a book. Pull up a chair. Choose a game. Bring a friend. Stay awhile.

Stopite noter, upočasnite in se počutite kot doma. Naša članska knjižnica je prijeten prostor, kjer se lahko udobno namestite v naslanjač ob kaminu, uživate v slovenski knjigi, obudite stike s prijatelji ali si preprosto vzamete čas zase.

Pripeljite prijatelja in ga izzovite na partijo šaha, backgammona, dame, Jenge ali kart; čaka vas še veliko drugih iger, ki jih lahko odkrijete in uživate v njih.

Ne glede na to, ali obujate slovenske zgodbe in izročilo, se ob igri smejete s prijatelji ali uživate v tihem trenutku ob ognju, je knjižnica prijazen prostor za člane vseh generacij.

Vzemite knjigo. Pristavite stol. Izberite igro. Pripeljite prijatelja. Ostanite še malo.

Home / Learn Slovenian

Learn Slovenian at the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra

Dobrodošli! — Welcome to your Slovenian language journey

🇸🇮

Dobrodošli! Welcome!

Whether you're reconnecting with your Slovenian heritage, preparing for a trip to Slovenia, learning to communicate with family, or simply looking to learn a new language, our Slovenian language classes are the perfect place to start.

Our classes are held at the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra in a welcoming classroom environment and are designed specifically for beginners. Lessons are interactive, practical, and enjoyable, with a focus on building confidence in speaking, listening, reading, and writing Slovenian.

Our 10-Week Beginner Program

Our Beginner Slovenian course is delivered as a 10-week program, providing students with a strong foundation in the Slovenian language while exploring Slovenian culture, traditions, and everyday life.

Students benefit from a complete learning experience that includes:

🇸🇮
A teacher from SloveniaLessons are taught live online by our Slovenian language teacher, bringing authentic language knowledge and cultural insight directly into the classroom.
📖
A student workbookProviding structured lessons and resources to support your learning throughout the course.
💻
An online learning platformAllowing students to practise between classes, revise lessons, and continue building their skills at their own pace.
🤝
A community of fellow Slovenian studentsLearn alongside others with a shared interest in the Slovenian language, creating opportunities to practise, encourage one another, and build friendships.

Our Classes

Our classes are held in a welcoming classroom environment at the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra, where students learn together in a friendly, interactive setting. Each lesson encourages participation, conversation, and practical language skills, giving students the confidence to use Slovenian from the very beginning.

Learning alongside fellow students also provides plenty of opportunities to practise between lessons, encourage one another, and build lasting friendships while becoming part of Canberra's growing Slovenian community.

Currently Running

Current Classes

We currently have one new beginners class and one beginners continuation class running on Wednesday night.

Trenutno imamo en nov začetniški tečaj in en nadaljevalni tečaj za začetnike, ki potekata ob sredah zvečer.

The response from our community has been incredible, and it is wonderful to see so many people embracing the Slovenian language.

Home / FAQs

Your Questions Answered

We're here to help!

Welcome to the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra's FAQ page! Whether you're new to the community or a longtime member, we're here to ensure you have all the information you need.

How can I become a member? ▼
Joining is easy and gives you access to all our events, discounts, and a community that celebrates Slovenian culture. Visit our Membership Page for full details on Associate and Ordinary membership options.
When are your events held? ▼
We host a variety of cultural and social events throughout the year! Our regular gatherings are:

Wednesday & Thursday — 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM
Friday — 4:30 PM – 9:30 PM
Saturday & Sunday — 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM

Hours are flexible — we stay open late if a function is on, so call before arriving! Check out our Events Calendar to find out what's happening next.

📌 Parking is available during club hours only. Outside these times, spaces are reserved for members with permits and enforced by a tow truck service.
PARKING PERMITS — Need somewhere to park outside club hours? ▼
Parking permits are available for purchase for those wishing to use the Club car park outside our normal operating hours.

Permits must be purchased in advance and displayed as required.

For permit availability, pricing and further information, please contact the Club →
Can I host an event at the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra? ▼
Yes! Our venue is available for hire for private events — birthdays, weddings, corporate functions and more. Our iconic Triglav-inspired venue, outdoor BBQ area, and welcoming atmosphere make it a truly unique setting. Visit our Venue Booking page for more details.
Do I need to be Slovenian to join? ▼
Not at all! We welcome everyone who has an interest in Slovenian culture, heritage, or community. Whether you are Slovenian by birth or Slovenian in spirit, you are welcome here.
How can I get involved with volunteering? ▼
Volunteering is a fantastic way to give back to the community and meet fellow members! We have opportunities in maintenance & building, event organisation, bar & function work, IT support, gardening, and more. Visit our Volunteer Page to register.
Are there Slovenian language resources available? ▼
Absolutely! The Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra offers Slovenian language classes every Wednesday evening at our club. Whether you're a complete beginner, looking to refresh your skills, or wanting to reconnect with your Slovenian heritage, our classes provide a fun and welcoming environment for all ages. Visit our Learn Slovenian Page for class information, enrolment details, and online learning resources. Both classes are currently fully booked — register your interest for our next intake!
Where can I listen to Slovenian radio? ▼
Whether you enjoy local community radio, national broadcasters, or live stations streaming directly from Slovenia, you can listen anytime. Visit our Radio & Links Page to tune in — or use our built-in radio player right here on the website!
Where are you located? ▼
We are located at 19 Irving St, Phillip ACT 2606. You can also reach us by phone on 02 6282 1083.
What is the Stara Trta? ▼
The Stara Trta (Old Vine) in Maribor, Slovenia is the oldest grape vine in the world — over 400 years old. Our club has its own cutting from this historic vine growing right here in Canberra, making us one of the few places outside of Slovenia to hold this honour.
How can I stay connected with Slovenian community in Canberra? ▼
Stay in the loop with the latest Slovenian news, events, and happenings across the globe! Follow us on social media and visit our links page:

📘 Facebook — Slovenian Australian Association Canberra
📷 Instagram — @slovenian_club_canberra
⭐ Google Reviews

You can also visit our Useful Links Page for more Slovenian community resources.
How can I learn more about Slovenian culture and heritage? ▼
Explore Slovenia's fascinating history, culture, and traditions on our Our History Page and Triglav Page.
Where can I read about Slovenia's history, culture, and festivals? ▼
Slovenia has a wonderfully rich heritage spanning centuries of art, music, folklore, and celebration! Here's where you can explore:

🏛️ Our History Page — the story of the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
🇸🇮 Discover Slovenian Culture — food, music, language, landmarks and more
🎉 Slovenian Festivals — I Feel Slovenia — official festival guide
📖 I Feel Slovenia — official tourism and culture portal
What are some of Slovenia's must-see destinations? ▼
Slovenia boasts incredible landmarks! Here are three must-see icons:

🏰 Ljubljana Castle — towering over the capital with panoramic views and rich cultural exhibits
🏞️ Lake Bled — a stunning alpine lake with a picturesque island church
🦎 Postojna Cave — Europe's most-visited show cave and a UNESCO-recognised site

🇸🇮 Discover Slovenian Culture — explore all of Slovenia's food, music, history and landmarks on our dedicated page
How can I attend Slovenian cultural events in Canberra? ▼
Find out about upcoming Slovenian events in Canberra by checking our Events Calendar. You can also visit our Discover Slovenian Culture page for food, music, language and more — no passport required! 🇸🇮
Are there any Slovenian recipes available? ▼
Bring the taste of Slovenia to your kitchen! Our Discover Slovenian Culture page has links to wonderful Slovenian recipe collections. You can also contribute your own family recipes to our community cookbook — Naša Miza!
How do I keep up to date with Slovenian events in Canberra? ▼
Stay informed on upcoming Slovenian events by checking out our Events Calendar. Our newsletter goes exclusively to members — become a member and you'll be automatically added!
Where can I find out about Slovenian festivals worldwide? ▼
Learn about Slovenia's major festivals and cultural celebrations through these great resources:

🎉 Slovenian Festivals — I Feel Slovenia — the official guide to festivals across Slovenia
🇸🇮 I Feel Slovenia — Slovenia's official tourism portal

Whether it's a heartwarming moment at an event, a memory from a festival, or how the club has become a second family — your voice is important. Share your story, and inspire others to join in the journey!

Take a moment to read the experiences of our members and see how our club has touched lives. And, if you're moved to share your own experience, we'd love to hear from you. Your story could be the one that sparks someone else's connection to our community.

Why join?

As a member, you'll gain access to special events, community gatherings, and exclusive perks — like discounts on Slovenian beers, a members-only library, and the chance to connect with others who share a love for Slovenia's rich traditions and Canberra's multicultural vibrancy.

Our members are the heart of everything we do — from celebrating cultural milestones to volunteering in projects that make a difference. Whether you're Slovenian by heritage or simply in spirit, we welcome everyone to join us. Step into a community that feels like home, honours tradition, and values every member's unique contribution.

November 2025

🍷
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
November 2025

Hosted by the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra

You are warmly invited to join us for one of Slovenia's most joyful traditions – Martinovanje in Canberra, the celebration of St. Martin's Day, when grapes transform into wine and the spirit of good food, music, and friendship fills the air.

Experience an unforgettable evening of Slovenian culture, wines, and world-class entertainment as we celebrate the joy of new wine, old traditions, and the vibrant spirit of Slovenia.

Featuring

Denis Novato – World Champion Accordionist and International Performer

Enjoy an exclusive concert by Denis Novato, a true virtuoso of the accordion who has performed on stages around the world, captivating audiences with his extraordinary skill, passion, and energy. Renowned for his dynamic performances and infectious enthusiasm, Denis brings the heart of Slovenia to every note. Don't miss this rare opportunity to experience one of the world's finest accordionists live in Canberra.

Also Performing

The Alpine Echoes — Dance the night away to their lively Slovenian beats and enjoy an atmosphere filled with joy, laughter, and music.

Enjoy a festive evening of food and drinks available at club prices. Raise a glass of wine, share in the warmth of Slovenian hospitality, and celebrate this cherished Slovenian tradition with friends, family, and community.

Event Details

Date: Friday, 14 November 2025
Time: 6:30 PM
Venue: Slovenian Club – 19 Irving Street, Phillip ACT 2606

Tickets (Concert Only)

  • Members: Contact us for 25
  • Non-Members: Contact us for 30
  • Children under 12: Free

Membership renewals are due in October 2025, so please renew your membership to obtain the member's price for this event.

RSVP

RSVP by Wednesday, 12 November 2025

To reserve your seat, please contact Natasha on 0401 219 330 or reply by return email.

Prepayment of tickets can be made to the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra club bank account:
NAB BSB: 082 926  ·  Account: 515 056 492

Join us for an evening of music, culture, and celebration — where Slovenia comes alive in the heart of Canberra!

On behalf of the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra Committee
Natasha Kapušin – President

Gosti Slovensko-avstralsko društvo Canberra

Vljudno vas vabimo, da se nam pridružite pri eni najradostnejših slovenskih tradicij – Martinovanju v Canberri, prazniku dneva sv. Martina, ko se grozdje pretvori v vino in v zraku zavlada duh dobre hrane, glasbe in prijateljstva.

Doživite nepozabno večer slovenske kulture, vin in nastopov svetovne kakovosti, ko bomo proslavljali veselje mladega vina, starih tradicij in živahnega duha Slovenije.

Nastopi

Denis Novato – svetovni prvak v harmoniki in mednarodni izvajalec

Uživajte v ekskluzivnem koncertu Denisa Novata, pravega virtuoza harmonike, ki je nastopil na odrih po vsem svetu in s svojo izrednim znanjem, strastjo in energijo navduševal občinstvo.

Nastopajo tudi

Alpski Odmevi — Plešite v ritmu živahnih slovenskih melodij in uživajte v atmosferi, polni veselja, smeha in glasbe.

Uživajte v praznični večeri s hrano in pijačo po cenah kluba. Dvignite kozarec vina, delite toplino slovenskega gostoljubja in praznujte to dragoceno slovensko tradicijo s prijatelji, družino in skupnostjo.

October 2025

🌟
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
October 2025

Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Newsletter

A Season of Progress and Excitement at Your Club

Since June, our committee has been hard at work — turning ambitious plans into reality and achieving what once seemed impossible. We are incredibly grateful to our members whose encouragement, support, and enthusiasm have inspired us to keep pushing forward. Your involvement and faith in our vision have made this committee a truly valuable part of the club, guiding its growth, strengthening our community, and ensuring that every step we take benefits our members.

Slowly but surely, we're watching our plans come to life, and while there's still more ahead, it's exhilarating to see it all unfolding before our eyes. The club has been buzzing with energy, and it truly shows. We've been busy renovating since end of 2024, working our way through grant funding and breathing new life into our space. It's been a massive team effort — and we're delighted to say it's paying off!

Stronger Together – Collaboration with the Slovenian Association Sydney

We're proud to announce a renewed partnership between the Slovenian-Australian Association Canberra and the Slovenian Association Sydney — reconnecting two communities with shared roots and a rich history of collaboration dating back to the 1970s.

Our forefathers understood the power of connection, with regular bus trips and joint events that kept the Slovenian spirit alive across ACT and NSW. Today, we're bringing that legacy back! We've already kicked off our first event with a 20-seater bus taking a group of Canberrans to Sydney to enjoy their lively Oktoberfest celebration — an unforgettable experience full of music, laughter, and cultural connection.

Looking ahead, we are planning more bus trips between the two clubs, giving members from both states the chance to celebrate functions together, share traditions, and strengthen the bonds within our wider Slovenian-Australian community. Even better, our members now enjoy reciprocal rights — meaning you can attend functions at the other club at members' rates, opening the door to even more shared experiences.

From language and folklore to Slovenian music acts and folklore dancing, this partnership will create countless opportunities to celebrate our heritage, build friendships, and strengthen our Slovenian identity — together.

Renovations and Upgrades — Wow, Wow, Wow!

We've upgraded our kitchen, decked out with the latest commercial kitchen equipment, and a new servery for the beer garden that's just awaiting the final touches. Our disabled toilet at the rear, and the main toilets are nearly finished. The bar now boasts a brand-new coffee machine, and our boardroom has been cleared out to make way for a classroom — another step forward in our commitment to learning and cultural connection. Outside, we have a new garbage area, a new garage door, and fresh lighting all around the club that really makes the place shine.

And the best part? We're still not done. There's more grant funding to be used, and we'll reveal the next round of improvements as soon as they begin.

Our New Restaurant is Almost Here – Don't Miss Out!

We're just finalising our restaurant contract, and we couldn't be more excited! Those who've been lucky enough to taste our chef's food already know — it's going to be something special. We'll be holding an exclusive member-only opening, so make sure your membership is up to date to receive your invitation.

Celebrating Our Culture and Community

This year has been full of special moments that remind us why we do what we do. The Independence Day function was an unforgettable celebration — a wonderful blend of tradition, pride, and community spirit. The atmosphere was electric, the music uplifting, and the turnout inspiring. It was a true reflection of who we are — a community that celebrates its heritage while embracing everyone who walks through our doors.

Our Welcome Home event in Nova Gorica was absolutely unforgettable — a breathtaking experience for so many in our Canberra community. Through funding secured by the Canberra Club, we were thrilled to extend this life-changing opportunity to Vosa Radio in Sydney as well. Participants embarked on a journey to Slovenia, immersed themselves in its rich culture, reconnected with their roots, and created memories that will last a lifetime. We are immensely grateful to the Urad Republike Slovenije za Slovence v zamejstvu in po svetu (Office for Slovenians Abroad) for their support, which made this extraordinary adventure possible — truly, the magic of Slovenian heritage came alive like never before!

What's Coming Up — Save the Dates!

Friday 14 November – St. Martin's Day (Sveti Martin Dan) – Martinovanje in Canberra

Get ready for one of our most anticipated celebrations of the year — Martinovanje in Canberra! This special evening marks the blessing of the new wine, and we're thrilled to be celebrating it in true Slovenian style. The night will feature world-renowned button accordion maestro Denis Novato and the always energetic Alpine Echoes. Expect an unforgettable evening filled with music, dancing, laughter, and that unmistakable Slovenian spirit that brings everyone together.

  • Date: Friday, 14 November 2025
  • Time: 6:30 PM
  • Venue: Slovenian Club – 19 Irving Street, Phillip ACT 2606
  • Tickets (Concert Only): Members – $25 · Non-Members – $30 · Children under 12 – Free
  • RSVP by Wednesday, 12 November 2025. Contact Natasha on 0401 219 330 or reply by email. Prepayment to NAB BSB: 082 926, ACC: 515 056 492

Sunday 7 December – Miklavž Celebration
A magical and heartwarming day for our youngest members as Miklavž makes his annual visit to the club with gifts, laughter, and festive joy.

Friday 26 December – St. Stefan's Day (Sveti Štefan)
Come along as we honour this traditional Slovenian celebration, often associated with the blessing of horses and community togetherness.

Wednesday 31 December – New Year's Eve Party
Ring in 2026 with your Slovenian-Australian family and dance the night away with the Alpine Echoes! Great music, laughter, drinks, and dancing — there's no better place to welcome the new year than right here at your club.

Club Hours and Sunday Fun!

Our club is buzzing with activity! Currently, we're open Fridays from 5:00 PM to 9:30 PM and Sundays from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Private function hours expand once our restaurant officially opens.

Exciting news — we now have a brand-new coffee machine at the bar! Sunday afternoons are perfect for card games and friendly competition.

Be a Festival Star Volunteer – Join the 2026 Multicultural Celebration Team!

Thursday 6 – Saturday 8 February 2026 – Multicultural Festival
We're calling on all members and friends to help create an unforgettable celebration of culture, food, music, and friendship.

Membership Renewals Are Here!

Full Members, Associate Members, and Carpark Members, please ensure your membership is renewed to maintain access to member benefits and functions.

Language and Dance – Keeping Culture Alive

Register your interest for Slovenian language or traditional dance lessons. We are also looking for teachers and instructors from our community to help preserve our traditions.

Working Bees – Lending a Hand and Sharing a Laugh

Join our working bees on the first Saturday of every month. The next one is on Saturday, 6 December.

Website and Social Media – Coming Soon!

Stay connected through our upcoming website and social media channels for updates, events, and cultural stories.

Share Your Slovenian Travel Moments or Life Stories!

Send your photos and stories from Slovenia to Natasha to showcase your experiences on our website and social media.

A Message from the Committee

Thank you to all our members for your ongoing support and dedication. Together, we are keeping Slovenian culture alive, vibrant, and thriving right here in Canberra.

On behalf of the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra Committee
Natasha Kapušin, President

Slovensko-avstralsko društvo Canberra – Glasilo

Sezona napredka in vznemirjenja v vašem klubu

Od junija naprej naš odbor trdo dela — uresničuje ambiciozne načrte in dosega to, kar je včasih izgledalo nemogoče. Izredno smo hvaležni našim članom, katerih spodbuda, podpora in navdušenje so nas navdihovale, da smo vztrajali.

Počasi, a zanesljivo gledamo, kako naši načrti oživljajo. Klub je bil poln energije. Prenavljamo od konca 2024, porabljamo sredstva iz nepovratnih sredstev in vdihujemo nov život našemu prostoru.

Skupaj smo močnejši – Sodelovanje s Slovenskim društvom Sydney

Ponosno naznanjamo obnovljeno partnerstvo med Slovensko-avstralskim društvom Canberra in Slovenskim društvom Sydney — ki znova povezuje dve skupnosti s skupnimi koreninami in bogato zgodovino sodelovanja.

Že smo začeli s prvim dogodkom – avtobus z 20 mesti je odpeljal skupino Canberrancev v Sydney na živahno Oktobersko praznovanje. Načrtujemo še več avtobusnih izletov med obema kluboma. Naši člani imajo zdaj vzajemne pravice — obisk prireditev v drugem klubu po cenah za člane.

Prenove in nadgradnje — Bravo, bravo, bravo!

Nadgradili smo kuhinjo z najnovejšo komercialno opremo, dodali novo točilnico za pivski vrt, zaključili prenovo stranišč, namestili nov kavni aparat in uredili učilnico v sejni sobi. Zunaj imamo novo odlagalno območje, nova garažna vrata in svežo razsvetljavo po vsem klubu.

Naša nova restavracija je tukaj kmalu!

Ravno zaključujemo pogodbo za restavracijo in ne moremo biti bolj navdušeni! Organizirali bomo ekskluzivno otvoritev samo za člane — poskrbite, da je vaše članstvo posodobljeno.

Prihajajo dogodki — Shranite si datume!

October 2025

🍺
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
October 2025

Exciting news for our members!

Stronger Together!

We're proud to announce a renewed partnership between the Slovenian-Australian Association Canberra and Slovenian Association Sydney — reconnecting two communities with shared roots and a strong history of collaboration dating back to the 1970s.

Our forefathers knew the power of connection, with regular bus trips and joint events that kept the Slovenian spirit alive across ACT and NSW. We're bringing that legacy back — with shared cultural events, reciprocal associate memberships, and Canberra–Sydney bus trips on the horizon.

From language and folklore to Slovenian international music acts and folklore dancing, this partnership will create more opportunities to celebrate our heritage, build friendships, and strengthen our Slovenian identity — together.

Each club proudly maintains its own identity, but together, we're building a more vibrant and connected Slovenian community across NSW & ACT.

We can't wait to see you at our clubs! 😊

Anthony Tomazin    Natasha Kapušin
President SAS        President SAA

Skupaj še močnejši!

S ponosom naznanjamo obnovljeno partnerstvo med Slovensko-avstralskim društvom Canberra in Slovenskim društvom Sydney, ki ponovno povezuje dve skupnosti s skupnimi koreninami in močno zgodovino sodelovanja, ki sega v sedemdeseta leta prejšnjega stoletja.

Naši predniki so se zavedali moči povezovanja, saj so z rednimi avtobusnimi izleti in skupnimi prireditvami ohranjali slovenski duh v državah ACT in NSW. To zapuščino vračamo nazaj - s skupnimi kulturnimi dogodki, vzajemnim pridruženim članstvom in tudi avtobusnimi izleti Canberra-Sydney.

Od jezika, folklore do slovenskih glasbenih nastopov, folklornih plesov bo to partnerstvo ustvarilo več priložnosti za praznovanje naše dediščine, sklepanje novih, ohranjanje starih prijateljstev in krepitev naše skupne slovenske identitete.

Vsak klub ponosno ohranja svojo identiteto, skupaj pa gradimo bolj živahno in povezano slovensko skupnost tako v NSW in ACT.

Komaj čakamo, da vas vidimo v naših klubih! 😊

What's Happening at the Slovenian Australian Association CanberraKaj se dogaja v Slovensko-avstralskem društvu Canberra

June 2025

🏆
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
June 2025

What's happening at the Slovenian Australian Association Canberra - June

United by Culture, Empowered by Progress — Our Gold Standard Community

Dear Members and Friends,

You may have noticed we've been a little quiet lately — but that's only because we've been busier than ever behind the scenes. The energy at the club is real, the progress is visible, and the future is bright.

A Win: We've Been Awarded Gold

We're proud to announce that the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra has received a Canberra Gold Award, presented in March during Canberra's birthday celebrations.

This award recognises our longstanding contribution to the cultural and community life of the ACT. It is a tribute to every single member, volunteer, and supporter who has kept our club alive through decades of dedication. We're honoured — and more motivated than ever.

Major Upgrades: Kitchen, Facilities & More

The kitchen renovation is now 98% complete — a beautiful, functional space that will open the door to bigger and better events.

We're currently interviewing contract caterers to bring high-quality meals and authentic Slovenian flavours back to our tables.

Our monthly working bees have also been keeping the club in top shape. Thank you to all who've been showing up with tools, energy, and a helping hand. Your efforts are deeply appreciated.

We now have new lights around the outside of the club and the billboard is now working.

Upcoming Event – June Dinner Dance Celebration

Slovenian Statehood Day & Slovenian Father's Day Dinner Dance
Saturday 14 June 2025 at 6:00pm
Live music by Alpenski Echoes
$50 for members | $55 for non-members

Let's celebrate Slovenia's independence and honour the fathers and grandfathers in our lives with a night of food, live music, and dancing. Whether you come for the culture, the community or the conversation — don't miss this meaningful celebration.

RSVP via email or Facebook.

Event Highlights: Culture, Tradition, Connection

  • March – Pust Masquerade Dinner Dance: A vibrant evening full of colour, music, and tradition.
  • April – ANZAC Day Gathering: A respectful and heartfelt remembrance.
  • April – Easter Buterice & Egg Painting: A joyful family celebration.
  • May – Chestnut & Mulled Wine Afternoon: Slovenian winter warmth shared by the fire.

Coming Soon: Language & Dance Lessons

Slovenian language lessons will begin in Spring, open to all ages and levels.

We are also planning to introduce traditional dance lessons and are looking for a dance teacher. If you or someone you know is interested, please contact us.

Representing Canberra in Slovenia: Welcome Home 2025

From 20–22 June, a group of our members will proudly represent the club at the Welcome Home Event in Nova Gorica, Slovenia — the largest global gathering of Slovenians.

What's Next: Bathrooms, Beer Garden & Website Launch

  • Bathroom renovations (modern, clean, accessible)
  • Beer garden redevelopment for outdoor gatherings
  • New club website — launching soon

We're building a modern club with a strong cultural heart — for today and tomorrow.

Stay Connected – Follow & Share

Facebook: Slovenian Australian Association Canberra
Instagram: Slovenian Australian Association Canberra

Volunteers Make It All Possible

Every renovation, project, and event at the club is powered by volunteers. Thank you for your continued dedication.

Next Working Bee – Join Us

Saturday 6 July at 8:00 AM
All welcome — no experience needed.

A Special Thank You to Our Costume Donors

Your donated traditional costumes preserve our identity and honour our heritage. We are truly grateful.

Archiving Our Legacy — Preserving Club History

We have officially begun archiving decades of historical documents, photographs, and memorabilia to protect our shared heritage for future generations.

No passport required to discover Slovenian culture — just bring yourself.

We can't wait to see you soon — at the club, on the dance floor, around the table or by the fire.

On behalf of the committee,
Natasha Kapušin
President
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Incorporated

Združeni s kulturo, opolnomočeni z napredkom — naša skupnost zlatega standarda

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

Morda ste opazili, da smo bili zadnje čase nekoliko tiho — ampak samo zato, ker smo bili za kulisami bolj zaposleni kot kdaj koli. Energija v klubu je resnična, napredek je viden in prihodnost je svetla.

Zmaga: Prejeli smo zlato nagrado

Ponosno sporočamo, da je Slovensko-avstralsko društvo Canberra prejelo Zlato nagrado Canberr, podeljeno marca med praznovanjem Canberrinega rojstnega dne.

Ta nagrada prepoznava naš dolgoletni prispevek h kulturnem in skupnostnem življenju ACT.

Večje nadgradnje: kuhinja, prostori in več

Prenova kuhinje je 98% dokončana. Trenutno izbiramo pogodbene gostince, ki bodo prinesli kakovostne obroke in pristne slovenske okuse nazaj na naše mize.

Naše mesečne delovne akcije so prav tako skrbele za klub v najboljši formi. Zahvala vsem, ki so prišli z orodjem, energijo in pripravljenostjo pomagati.

Sobota, 14. junij 2025 ob 18:00
Živa glasba: Alpski odmevi
$50 za člane | $55 za nečlane

Prihaja kmalu: jezikovni in plesni tečaji

Tečaji slovenščine bodo začeli spomladi, odprti za vse starosti in stopnje.

Zastopamo Canberra v Sloveniji: Welcome Home 2025

Od 20. do 22. junija bo skupina naših članov ponosno zastopala klub na dogodku Welcome Home v Novi Gorici, Slovenija.

V imenu odbora,
Nataša Kapušin

April 2025

Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
April 2025

ANZAC Day & Upcoming Events – April to June at the Club

Dear Members and Friends,

As we step into the next few months, we're pleased to share some exciting upcoming events at the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra—and we warmly invite you to take part.

Friday, 25th April 2025 – ANZAC Day

First and foremost, please join us this Friday, 25th April, for a very special ANZAC Day gathering. This is a significant occasion where we come together to honor the brave men and women who served Australia and New Zealand.

Our club will mark the day with a traditional game of two-up, along with our famous Kranjski Rolls and Apple Strudel. This is more than just a day of remembrance—it's also an opportunity to connect, reflect, and spend meaningful time with others in our community.

The gathering will commence at 11:00 AM, and we encourage all members, families, and friends to attend.

Sunday, 4th May 2025 – Chestnut Roasting and Mulled Wine

Looking ahead, on Sunday, 4th May, we're bringing a taste of Slovenia to Canberra with an afternoon of Chestnut Roasting and Mulled Wine. From 2:00 PM, enjoy this comforting Slovenian tradition—perfect for a crisp autumn day. Kids are welcome, and we'd love to see families joining in the fun.

Saturday, 14th June 2025 – Statehood Day & Slovenian Father's Day

Then on Saturday, 14th June, help us celebrate Slovenian Statehood Day and Slovenian Father's Day with an unforgettable evening of music, dancing, and great food, starting at 6:00 PM.

This year, we've brought Statehood Day forward to early June to combine it with Father's Day, in the hope that attendance will be higher before many of our members head overseas the following week.

Let's come together to reflect on Slovenia's proud journey to independence, and to honor the father figures in our lives with a night full of pride, appreciation, and joy.

We look forward to seeing you soon and sharing these special occasions with you.

Warm regards,
Natasha Kapušin
President
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Inc.

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

Ko vstopamo v naslednje mesece, z veseljem delimo nekatere vznemirljive prihajajože dogodke v Slovensko-avstralskem društvu Canberra — in vas toplo vabimo k sodelovanju.

Petek, 25. april 2025 – Dan ANZAC

Pridružite se nam ta petek, 25. aprila, na posebnem zborovanju ob dnevu ANZAC. Naš klub bo zaznamoval dan s tradicionalno igro dvoličnega kovanca, skupaj z našimi slavnimi Kranjskimi žemljicami in jabolčnim zavitkom. Zbiranje se bo začelo ob 11:00.

Nedelja, 4. maj 2025 – Pečenje kostanjev in kuhano vino

V nedeljo, 4. maja, prinašamo okus Slovenije v Canberra s popoldnevom pečenja kostanjev in kuhanega vina od 14:00. Otroci so dobrodošli.

Sobota, 14. junij 2025 – Dan državnosti in slovenski dan očetov

Praznujte z nami Dan državnosti in slovenski dan očetov z nepozabno večerjo glasbe, plesa in odlične hrane od 18:00.

Letos smo Dan državnosti prestavili na začetek junija, da sovpada z Dnem očetov.

Lep pozdrav,

Exciting Opportunity for Young Slovenians – Welcome Home Event in SloveniaVznemirljiva priložnost za mlade Slovence – Welcome Home v Sloveniji

April 2025

✈️
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
April 2025

Dear Members,

We're thrilled to share some wonderful news with you!

Our association has been awarded a grant that will allow us to take part in a very special international event – the "Welcome Home" gathering in Nova Gorica, Slovenia, from 20th to 23rd June 2025.

This event is part of a program designed to reconnect young people of Slovenian heritage from around the world with their cultural roots, build friendships, and experience Slovenia in a meaningful and memorable way.

We are now reaching out to people of Slovenian heritage under the age of 36 who may be interested in participating. This is an incredible opportunity to represent our community, meet others with shared heritage, and celebrate our Slovenian identity together in the heart of Slovenia.

Please note: Places are limited, and you must be an active member of the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra for the past 12 months to be considered.

When applying, please include a brief description of how you have been involved in our community.

Applications close: Thursday, 17th April at midday.

The Executive Committee will review all applications and make a final decision shortly thereafter.

For more information or to express interest, please reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Natasha Kapušin
President
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Inc.

Dragi člani,

Z veseljem vam sporočamo čudovito novico!

Našemu društvu je bila podeljena nepovratna sredstva, ki nam omogočajo udeležbo na posebnem mednarodnem dogodku – zborovanju »Welcome Home« v Novi Gorici, Slovenija, od 20. do 23. junija 2025.

Ta dogodek je namenjen ponovnem povezovanju mladih slovenskega porekla z vsega sveta z njihovimi kulturnimi koreninami, gradnji prijateljstev in doživljanju Slovenije na smiseln in nepozaben način.

Iščemo osebe slovenskega porekla mlajše od 36 let, ki bi jih to zanimalo. Mesta so omejena in biti morate aktivni član Slovensko-avstralskega društva Canberra vsaj 12 mesecev.

Pri prijavi prosimo navedite kratek opis vaše vpletenosti v naši skupnosti.

Rok za prijave: četrtek, 17. april opoldne.

Lep pozdrav,
Nataša Kapušin

Easter Message – Slovenian Australian Association of CanberraVelikonočno sporočilo – Slovensko-avstralsko društvo Canberra

April 2025

🐣
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
April 2025

Dragi člani in prijatelji – Dear members and friends,

On behalf of the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, we'd like to wish you all a joyful, peaceful, and heartfelt Happy Easter – or as we say in Slovenian, Vesel Velikonočni prazniki!

Easter is a time of renewal, hope, and togetherness. It's a time to pause, reflect, and be thankful – for our families, our friendships, and the vibrant Slovenian community we are all part of here in Australia.

Whether you're painting pirhi with your children, attending church services, or sharing potica and memories at the family table, we hope this Easter brings you warmth and love.

Let us also take a moment to remember those who are no longer with us, and keep their spirit alive in our traditions, our laughter, and the stories we pass down to future generations.

From our hearts to yours – Vesel Velika noč, and thank you for being part of our wonderful community.

Warm regards,
Natasha Kapušin
President
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Inc.

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

V imenu Slovensko-avstralskega društva Canberra vam želimo radostno, mirno in iskreno srečno Veliko noč — ali kakor rečemo v slovenščini, Vesel Velikonočni praznik!

Velika noč je čas obnove, upanja in skupnosti. Je čas za premor, razmislek in hvaležnost — za naše družine, prijateljstva in živahno slovensko skupnost, katere del smo vsi tukaj v Avstraliji.

Naj barvate pirhe z otroki, hodite k maši ali delite potico in spomine za družinsko mizo — upamo, da vam ta Velika noč prinese toplino in ljubezen.

Spomnimo se tudi tistih, ki niso več z nami, in ohranjajmo njihovega duha živega v naših tradicijah, smehu in zgodbah, ki jih prenašamo na prihodnje generacije.

Iz srca vam želimo — Vesel Velika noč in hvala, ker ste del naše čudovite skupnosti.

Lep pozdrav,
Nataša Kapušin
Predsednica
Slovensko-avstralsko društvo Canberra

February 2025

Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
February 2025

Community, Culture & Celebration – A Month of Achievements!

Dear Members and Friends,

What an incredible start to the year! February has been a month of remarkable achievements, teamwork, and exciting progress. From successful events to game-changing grants and fantastic projects taking shape, we have so much to celebrate!

At the heart of it all is our incredible community, strengthened by the dedication of our volunteers and committee. Your passion, hard work, and commitment ensure our heritage thrives for generations to come. Thank you for everything you do!

Here's a look at what we've achieved and the exciting events ahead!

Celebrating Our February Successes

Sewing Bee Brilliance

Thank you to everyone who participated in our Sewing Bee! The teamwork resulted in 10 magnificent costumes that we proudly paraded. Each stitch reflects our commitment to preserving Slovenian traditions. Monthly sewing bees are planned—stay tuned!

The Power of Volunteering – Working Bees in Full Swing!

Our weekly working bees are vital. From maintenance to beautification, your efforts are deeply appreciated—thank you!

A Kitchen Worth Celebrating!

Our kitchen renovations are nearly complete! This upgrade will improve our meal service and gatherings—a true team success!

Cultural Pride at the Multicultural Festival

What a success! With 42 volunteers, this was our best year yet. Thank you to everyone who helped showcase Slovenian culture!

Pust Magic – A Night to Remember!

Smaller in numbers but big in spirit! Highlights included our Ambassador and 'President Trump' in 'jail' and Best Dressed winners: a ladybird and bumblebee. Unforgettable fun!

Upcoming Events – March & April

Friday, 7th March 2025 – International Women's Day & Slovenian Mother's Day

Celebrate the amazing women in our lives. Bring a share plate and enjoy a night of laughter, gratitude, and connection!

Sunday, 6th April 2025 – Easter Festivities – A Free Fun Day for Kids!

  • Egg Painting – Let the kids get creative!
  • Butarice Making – Craft traditional Slovenian palm bundles.
  • Potica Tasting – Bring a sweet treat to share and enjoy the festive spirit!

Friday, 25th April 2025 – ANZAC Day Commemoration

Join us in honouring those who served, followed by Two-Up, the AFL ANZAC Clash, and our famous Kranjski Rolls.

RSVP Reminder: Please confirm your attendance. Accurate numbers help us plan better events!

Game-Changing News – 3 Grants Secured!

We've secured three incredible grants—two from the Slovenian Government and one from the Australian Federal Government! These will help us:

  • Renovate bathroom facilities for improved accessibility
  • Create a beautiful outdoor alfresco area
  • Support cultural events and purchase traditional costumes

This is a huge achievement—thank you to everyone for your support and dedication!

Opportunities & Volunteering

Kitchen Leasing Opportunity – Spread the Word!

Our newly renovated kitchen is available for leasing! Know someone interested in running a food business? Let them know!

Join Us for Our Monthly Working Bees!

Held every 2nd Sunday, with a special cleanup on Saturday, 8th March 2025. Come lend a hand and connect with others!

Bar Volunteer Roster – We Need You!

We're organizing our Friday night and event bar roster. If you can help, please reach out—it's a great way to be involved!

Community First – The Heart of Our Club

Everything we do is powered by community spirit. From cultural events to gatherings, your involvement keeps our Slovenian roots alive and creates a welcoming space for all generations.

Thank you for being part of our family. We can't wait to see you at our upcoming events!

On behalf of the Committee,
Natasha Kapušin
President
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra

New Year, New Energy – 2025 Starts Strong with Unstoppable Momentum and Big Plans Ahead!

Dear Members and Friends,

2025 has kicked off with unstoppable momentum! From vibrant working bees to creative sewing sessions, a sizzling Australia Day celebration, and preparations for the National Multicultural Festival, we are in full swing. Our two major projects have been extremely successful:

✔️ Our costumes are nearly READY for next Saturday's parade!
✔️ Our kitchen upgrade is on schedule and shaping up beautifully!

Now, let's dive into the excitement ahead!

Upcoming February Events – Don't Miss Out

Experience the Magic of Slovenia at the National Multicultural Festival!

Canberra, are you ready? The biggest cultural festival of the year is here, and we need YOU! This is our chance to showcase Slovenia's rich traditions, delicious food, and vibrant music to the world. Be part of it and make unforgettable memories!

Don't just hear about it—BE THERE! March in the parade, feast on authentic Slovenian food, and experience our culture like never before!

Find Us: South Glebe Park, Canberra City – Stalls F32 & F33

Festival Dates:

  • Friday, February 7th – 5:00 PM – 11:00 PM
  • Saturday, February 8th – 10:00 AM – 11:00 PM (featuring Prešeren Day celebrations!)
  • Sunday, February 9th – 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Join Us: March in the Multicultural Parade or help out in the marquee! Wave the Slovenian flag, wear traditional dress, or just bring your big smile! Call 0401 219 330 to join this incredible experience. Whether it's serving food, setting up, or helping at our stall, every hand counts. Let's make this 50th anniversary festival unforgettable!

Pust – Times Past Fancy Dress Dinner Dance

Don't miss one of the most festive and fun nights of the year! Put on your best costume and join us for music, dancing, and celebration!

  • Date: Saturday, February 22, 2025
  • Cost: $70 members | $75 non-members
  • Music: by Alpski Odmevi (Alpine Echoes)
  • RSVP: by Wednesday, February 19, 2025 for catering purposes

December & January Highlights – A Community in Motion!

  • St. Stefan's Day BBQ: We ended the year on a high note with a heartwarming celebration. Thank you to everyone who joined us!
  • New Year's Eve Party: We rang in 2025 with festive cheer, great company, and a dazzling midnight toast! Huge thanks to everyone who helped make the night unforgettable!
  • Sewing Bees: Our dedicated volunteers have worked tirelessly to ensure Slovenia shines at the festival! Thank you to our wonderful Australian friends for their help. Final sewing bees: Sunday, Feb 2 at 1:30 PM and Monday, Feb 3 at 6:00 PM.
  • Working Bees: Every Saturday at 8:00 AM, our volunteers keep the club running—your dedication is inspiring!
  • Australia Day BBQ Bash: A fantastic mix of sunshine, food, culture, and community. Thank you to everyone who made it happen!

Building for a Bright Future – Kitchen & Maintenance Updates

Kitchen Renovation Update

We're making great progress, and soon we'll be opening expressions of interest for leasing the kitchen! If you know a qualified chef looking for a commercial kitchen space, let us know!

Working Bees

Join us every Saturday at 8:00 AM to help maintain and improve our facilities. Whether you're handy with tools or just want to support—everyone is welcome!

Stay Connected & Get Involved!

  • Club Opening Hours: Friday evenings & Sunday afternoons—come by and say hello!
  • Slovenian Radio Program: Tune in to VOSA every Saturday, 8 AM – 10 AM on 89.3 FM, 2GL for music, culture, and community news.
  • New Website Coming Soon: A fresh way to connect with us—stay tuned!

A Heartfelt Thank You to Our Incredible Volunteers

A massive thank you to everyone who helped bring our beautiful new national costumes to life. Your dedication allows us to proudly march in the 50th year of the National Multicultural Festival, showcasing Slovenian heritage in true style.

We also thank all those involved in the kitchen renovation. Your time, skill, and effort have been vital. We're creating something truly special for our community—together.

We appreciate each and every one of you for the difference you make. Thank you for your amazing contributions!

2025 is a year of growth, connection, and celebration!

Get involved. Get excited. Let's make this year unforgettable!

Na zdravje!
On behalf of the committee,
Natasha Kapušin

Dear Members and Friends,

As 2024 comes to an end, the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra is reflecting on a year filled with memorable achievements and looking ahead to an exciting 2025. From festive celebrations to cultural milestones, we've had an extraordinary journey together.

Let's pause to celebrate the heart and soul of our community—you. This has been a year of connection, resilience, and unforgettable moments that have deepened our bonds and reignited our shared passion for Slovenian and Australian culture. Together, we've accomplished so much, and as we look to 2025, the best is yet to come. Wishing you all a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year filled with joy and connection!

December Highlights – Moments to Remember

Miklavž Celebration: The room was filled with laughter and joy as families came together to celebrate this timeless tradition. For those who joined us, thank you for making it magical. If you missed it—make sure to mark your calendar next year!

In the Spotlight: Did you catch us on ABC News Radio, Television, and RiotACT? Our story about the stolen National Costumes showcased our resilience and commitment to preserving Slovenian culture. What a proud moment for our community!

Parliament House Recognition: Huge congratulations to Natasha Kapušin and Josie Bresnik for their awards honouring their outstanding service. Your dedication inspires us all—thank you for leading the way!

Merry Christmas 2024Vesele Božične praznike 2024

December 2024

🎄
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
December 2024

Dear Members and Friends,

Christmas is a time to celebrate everything that makes us strong as a community—our shared traditions, our families, the friendships we have nurtured, and the memories we've created together. It's a moment to reflect on how far we've come, from preserving our rich Slovenian culture to building a place where everyone feels welcome, valued, and supported.

Christmas is also about looking outward. It's about the joy of giving, the beauty of kindness, and the strength we find in supporting one another. Regardless of our faiths or backgrounds, this time of year reminds us of the importance of love, compassion, and the bonds that connect us all. Let's remember those in our community who may feel alone or have no one to share this season with. A kind word, a visit, or even just reaching out to someone in need can make all the difference. Together, we can ensure that no one is left without the warmth, safety, and love that Christmas promises.

As we gather together, let's celebrate the spirit of inclusivity, generosity, and togetherness that binds us. Our club is more than just a place—it's a home. A home that bridges the traditions of Slovenia with the spirit of Australia. It's a place filled with laughter, resilience, and the pride of knowing we're part of something greater.

Let's carry this spirit into the New Year—dream big, grow stronger, and continue building a community that honors friendship, cultural pride, and the legacy we're creating for future generations.

From the bottom of my heart, I wish each of you and your families a Christmas filled with joy, peace, and togetherness. May the New Year bring hope, excitement, and endless opportunities for us all. Thank you for making this community so extraordinary. Merry Christmas and Happy New Year to all!

On behalf of the Committee,
Natasha Kapušin
President
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Inc

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

Božič je čas za praznovanje vsega, kar nas dela močne kot skupnost — naših skupnih tradicij, naših družin, prijateljev, ki smo jih negovali, in spominov, ki smo jih skupaj ustvarili.

Božič je tudi čas za gledanje navzven. Je radost darila, lepota prijaznosti in moč, ki jo najdemo v medsebojni podpori. Spomnimo se tistih v naši skupnosti, ki se morda počutijo same ali nimajo nikogar, s katerim bi delili ta čas.

Ko se zberemo skupaj, praznujmo duha vključenosti, velikodušnosti in skupnosti, ki nas združuje. Naš klub je več kot le kraj — je dom. Dom, ki premošča tradicije Slovenije z duhom Avstralije.

Iz srca vam želim, da bi bili vi in vaše družine božič polni veselja, miru in skupnosti. Naj novo leto prinese upanje, vznemirjenje in neskončne priložnosti. Srečen Božič in Srečno Novo leto vsem!

V imenu odbora,
Nataša Kapušin
Predsednica
Slovensko-avstralsko društvo Canberra
