Slovenian Costumes Missing — We Need Your HelpManjkajo Slovenian kostumi — Potrebujemo vašo pomoč

November 2024

👗
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
November 2024

Dear Members and Friends,

As everyone is aware we have the Multi-Cultural Event coming up in the first week of February 2025 and our National Costumes have gone missing. Yes, we have lost our beautiful collection of National and dance costumes, so we need our memberships help.

The committee is reaching out to our membership to see who has national costumes and we are hoping that you will participate in our parade wearing your own costume.

If you own a costume and cannot participate or no longer fit into your costume, please let us know if you would be happy to lend your costume to the club for another member to showcase your beautiful National Costume in the parade.

If we don't have enough costumes, we will unfortunately need to cancel our participation in the parade.

We have been advised by a few members that this year will be 50 years since we first marched together with 11 other nations in our National Costumes. The committee encourages our Slovenian Community to look in your cupboards, dust off your National Costumes and join in the Slovenian Spirit.

Please register by return email if you would like to participate in the Multi-Cultural Parade, whether you have our own costume or are happy to loan it to a fellow Slovenian member for the parade.

On behalf of the committee,
Natasha Kapušin
President / Secretary
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Inc

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

Kot vsi veste, imamo prihajajoci Multikulturni festival v prvem tednu februarja 2025 in naši narodni kostumi so izginili. Da, izgubili smo našo lepo zbirko narodnih in plesnih kostumov, zato potrebujemo pomoč naših članov.

Odbor se obrača na naše članstvo, da ugotovimo, kdo ima narodne kostume in upamo, da boste sodelovali v naši paradi in nosili lastni kostum.

Če imate kostum in ne morete sodelovati ali vam ne ustreza več, nam sporočite, ali bi bili pripravljeni posoditi kostum klubu, da ga drug član nosi v paradi.

Letos bo 50 let, odkar smo prvič korakali skupaj z 11 drugimi narodi v naših narodnih kostumih. Odbor spodbuja naše slovensko skupnost, da pogledajo v svoje omare, otresejo prah s kostumov in se pridružijo slovenskemu duhu.

V imenu odbora,
Nataša Kapušin
Predsednica / Tajnica
Slovensko-avstralsko društvo Canberra

Home / Newsletter / All Newsletters / November 2024

Join Us for Our National Costume Reproduction Workshops!Pridružite se nam pri delavnicah za reprodukcijo narodnih kostumov!

November 2024

🪡
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
November 2024

Dear Members and Friends,

In the face of adversity, we stand strong and resilient, refusing to let anyone dim our shine! While we may have lost our beloved costumes, we now have a unique opportunity to come together and craft something beautiful that celebrates our vibrant Slovenian heritage.

A group of dedicated volunteers from a historical activity group with expertise in period costume reproduction, headwear, and pattern making, will guide us through our National Costume Reproduction. This is more than just a chance to recreate what we've lost; it's an invitation to deepen our connection to our culture and start a new tradition that showcases our creativity as we write another chapter in our Slovenian story.

As we prepare for our 50th parade, imagine the pride we will feel wearing costumes that we've made ourselves! No longer will we have to walk and dance in the parade wearing just our petticoats—this time, we'll shine in our newly crafted costumes! We will create these costumes for the club and make them available for you to borrow whenever needed. This milestone event will be even more memorable as we proudly display our collective efforts, celebrating our community's spirit.

We have a role for everyone, so don't worry if you can't sew! Let's unite our talents and passion to create a vibrant tapestry of our heritage. Whether you're a sewing superstar, a novice, or have an eye for embroidery, we warmly invite you to express your interest by replying to this email. Together, we can create costumes that reflect our dedication and commitment to our rich traditions.

Join us in this exciting journey, and let's make magic happen! Your participation will enrich our project and strengthen our bonds as a community.

Together, we are unstoppable!

On behalf of the Committee,
Natasha Kapušin
President / Secretary
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Inc

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

Pred izzivi stojimo trdni in vzdržljivi, in nočemo dovoliti, da bi nas kdo zasenčil! Čeprav smo morda izgubili naše drage kostume, imamo zdaj edinstveno priložnost, da se združimo in ustvarimo nekaj lepega, kar praznuje našo živahno slovensko dediščino.

Skupina predanih prostovoljcev iz zgodovinsko-aktivnostne skupine s strokovnim znanjem na področju reprodukcije kostumov bo vodila naše delavnice reprodukcije narodnih kostumov. To je več kot le priložnost za poustvaritev tega, kar smo izgubili — je povabilo za poglobitev naše povezave s kulturo.

Ko se pripravljamo na 50. parado, si predstavljajte ponos, ki ga bomo čutili, ko bomo nosili kostume, ki smo jih sami naredili! Ne bo nam več treba korakati v samih podkrilih — tokrat bomo sijali v lastnorocno ustvarjenih kostumih!

Imamo vlogo za vsakogar, zato ne skrbite, če ne znate šivati! Bodisi ste šivanje zvezdnik, začetnik ali imate oko za vezenje — toplo vas vabimo.

Skupaj smo neustavljivi!

V imenu odbora,
Nataša Kapušin

October Newsletter: A Time of Growth and CommunityOktobersko glasilo: Čas rasti in skupnosti

October 2024

🍂
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra
October 2024

October Newsletter: A Time of Growth and Community

October was a month of remarkable energy and excitement at our Club! As we welcomed a smooth transition to our new Committee, we remained laser-focused on our ongoing projects that breathe life into our shared vision.

A huge thank-you to our dedicated Committee members and invaluable volunteers! Your relentless hard work and positive spirit are leading our Club in a vibrant new direction. Your passion and commitment are the heart and soul of our success, and we are incredibly grateful for all that you bring to our community.

Our purpose remains steadfast: to uphold our Club as the cultural heart of the Slovenian community while offering a welcoming haven for our Australian neighbors. Preserving Slovenian heritage is at the core of everything we do, and we warmly invite you to immerse yourself in the traditions, hospitality, and camaraderie that make our community truly special.

Exciting improvements are on the horizon! Our committee is prioritising the construction of a new kitchen, along with several other essential projects aimed at revitalising and enhancing our beloved Club. We can't wait to share these updates with you as they unfold!

As always, our regular social events continue, with doors open on Friday nights from 5pm and Sunday afternoons from 2pm. Attendance on Sundays has been lively, with a warm atmosphere and friendly competition filling the air as members engage in spirited card games. Thank you for your enthusiasm and participation that make each gathering a cherished memory!

We are eager to embrace another month filled with growth, community spirit, and shared enjoyment. Your presence truly makes our Club a remarkable place, and we look forward to celebrating our heritage and community together!

Membership Renewal Time!

October is here, and it's time to renew your memberships for 2024/2025! Aligned with our constitution, memberships are due each October, so we encourage you to visit the Club to renew and enjoy our welcoming atmosphere with friends, old and new, on Friday nights or Sunday afternoons.

Membership dues remain at their current rates: Associate Members renew for $5, and Full Members for $10. For those interested in upgrading to Full Membership, which includes voting rights and eligibility for election to the Committee, the first-year cost is $302, with a $10 annual renewal fee thereafter. Full Membership also allows you to participate in the AGM and vote on club matters.

Your membership provides unique benefits and, most importantly, is an investment in our shared Slovenian heritage and the strong community spirit that makes our Club so special. Join us in carrying forward the vision and values established by our founders and families and help us continue building a vibrant future together!

Membership Benefits: Cheers to Exclusive Perks!

Exciting news for Life and Full members! Now, enjoy exclusive discounts on cartons of Slovenia's beloved Lasko and Union beers, bringing a taste of home right to your gatherings. Don't miss out - swing by the Club on Fridays or Sundays to find out more and stock up at members-only prices!

Raise a glass to our vibrant community and enjoy these unique perks of being a valued member!

Carpark Update

We're excited to announce that starting 1st November 2024, we will be implementing a new carpark management system to ensure that our designated spaces are reserved for our valued carpark park permit members. To help maintain a safe and accessible environment, we will be partnering with a towing company to remove vehicles that are parked without a valid carpark permit.

New signage will be installed to clearly outline the conditions for entry, making it easier for everyone to understand the parking rules. We appreciate your cooperation in this matter, as it will help us enhance the experience for all who visit our Club! Thank you for your cooperation in keeping our carpark a positive experience for everyone—together, we're creating a welcoming and organised space for our community!

Culture & Entertainment: Honouring Slovenian Tradition and Heritage — A Huge Success!

At our Club, we cherish the rich traditions and heritage of the Slovenian community. From lively social gatherings to the celebration of cultural events like Sveti Martin Dan, every occasion reflects our commitment to preserving the customs that have been passed down through generations.

Our events provide a warm setting to reconnect with familiar faces, welcome new members, and share the beauty of Slovenian music, food, and folklore with our Australian neighbors. By joining us, you're not just attending an event—you're helping to keep our cultural spirit alive and vibrant. Let's continue to celebrate the heart of our community, together!

October Event: A Celebration to Remember!

October 13, Sunday: We celebrated the oldest vine in Slovenia and our own backyard treasure—a prized offcut of the over 400-year-old "Stara Trta" from Maribor—paired with a mouthwatering BBQ!

October was nothing short of spectacular for our Club! We enjoyed a fantastic turnout, welcoming both new Slovenian and Australian members as well as visitors from Sydney, all coming together to embrace our vibrant community. The BBQ event was a lively celebration brimming with laughter, camaraderie, and a rich tapestry of culture. The air was filled with enchanting melodies from talented accordion and guitar players, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere that drew everyone in.

What truly warmed our hearts was seeing the younger generation of Slovenians unite with long-standing members, forging new connections and sharing in the rich cultural heritage that defines us. Our membership is growing, attracting both Slovenian and non-Slovenian members who share our love for community and culture. Together, we celebrated not just our roots but also the bonds that continue to flourish within our ever-expanding club.

With this spirit of unity, we're more excited than ever for the journey ahead and the many opportunities to come. Let's keep the energy alive and look forward to even more exciting events as we build our club's future together!

November Event: Celebrate Sveti Martin Dan!

Join us Sunday, November 10th, for an unforgettable kickoff to the wine season! Toast to Sveti Martin Dan with an exquisite selection of Slovenian wines and a BBQ lunch among friends.

Event Details:
Time: 12:30 PM Start
Cost: $25 for Members, $30 for Non-Members, $12 for Children (includes BBQ lunch) Wine Tasting: Enjoy a delightful sample tasting of three different Slovenian wines for just $5!
RSVP: By Friday, November 8, 2024, for catering purposes

Raise a glass to heritage, flavour, and community! This is the perfect opportunity to enjoy Slovenia's vibrant tastes and traditions. Don't miss out—join us for a wonderful day of food, wine, and connection!

Exciting Upcoming Events in 2024!

November 10, Sunday: Raise your glasses for Sveti Martin Dan, the dazzling kickoff to the wine season! Join us for an exquisite Wine Tasting featuring our finest Slovenian wines available at the bar. Discover the rich cultural heritage behind each bottle as we toast to the flavours of our homeland and the traditions that unite us!

December 8, Sunday: Get ready for enchantment! Experience Miklavzevanje (Blessings of St. Nicholas) with a festive BBQ that'll warm your heart. The highlight of the evening? A special visit from the stately Svet Miklavz himself, especially for the children! Gather your loved ones for an unforgettable celebration filled with joy, community, and the cherished traditions that make our heritage unique!

December 26, Thursday: Celebrate the spirit of unity! Join us for Sveti Stefan Dan / Slovenian Independence and Unity Day with our lively Boxing Day BBQ! Connect with fellow members, enjoy delicious food, and share stories that honor our incredible culture.

December 31, Tuesday: Ring in the New Year with a bang! Join us for a spectacular New Year's Eve Dinner/Dance that promises to be the highlight of your holiday season! Indulge in delectable dishes rooted in Slovenian tradition, enjoy lively performances from a talented Slovenian band and singer, dance the night away, and celebrate fresh beginnings filled with hope and excitement for the year to come!

To ensure every event is a resounding success, we kindly ask our members to pre-book and pre-pay for events. This allows us to tailor the experience just for you, ensuring a celebration that's nothing short of spectacular!

The Committee is buzzing with excitement to welcome our cherished members and their guests (who can sign up as Associate members) to these amazing celebrations! Thank you for your unwavering support. Together, let's make our Clubhouse the vibrant heart of our community as we celebrate our rich Slovenian culture and the beautiful traditions that bind us!

Membership & Volunteering: Embrace Our Slovenian Spirit!

Becoming a member and volunteering with us is a powerful way to celebrate and share the beauty of Slovenian heritage. Through membership, we pass down our vibrant traditions to younger generations and warmly welcome our community neighbors to experience Slovenia's culture firsthand. Canberra's multicultural spirit provides us with a wonderful platform to serve as ambassadors for our beautiful Slovenia, honouring our roots while building strong bonds for the future.

Our Club is thriving, thanks to members who have not only joined but also brought friends and family into the fold. Many are stepping up to volunteer, strengthening our community with energy and dedication. Whether you're new to the Club or have been with us for years, there are many ways to get involved. Drop by during our opening hours, have a chat, and find out how you can contribute to our growing Slovenian community. Let's celebrate, preserve, and share our heritage together!

Get Ready for the Multi-Cultural Parade: Let's Shine Together!

Exciting news, everyone! The Multi-Cultural Event is just around the corner, taking place in the first week of February 2025! We're thrilled to be part of this vibrant celebration, especially as we commemorate 50 incredible years since we first marched proudly with 11 other nations in our stunning National Costumes.

But we need your help! Unfortunately, our treasured collection of National and dance costumes has gone missing. Together, we can keep our vibrant spirit alive and ensure our participation in this spectacular event!

Calling all members: If you have a national costume, we want you to join the parade! Imagine the joy of showcasing our beautiful heritage, dancing, and celebrating alongside fellow community members. Your costume is a symbol of pride and tradition, and we can't wait to see you in it!

If you own a costume but can't participate or have outgrown it, we'd love your support in lending it to the Club. This way, another member can step into your beautiful attire and carry our legacy forward!

Let's not allow the absence of our costumes to dim our shine! If we don't gather enough costumes, we might have to sit this one out, and we certainly don't want that!

So, Slovenian Community, it's time to rally! Dust off those costumes, embrace the spirit of togetherness, and let's make a grand entrance! This is our moment to celebrate our culture, showcase our unity, and share the vibrancy of Slovenia with everyone around us!

Ready to strut your stuff? Please respond to this email to register for the Multi-Cultural Parade, whether you're bringing your own costume or would like to lend yours to a fellow member.

Thank you for your enthusiasm and support. Together, let's make this celebration one for the history books—let's shine brighter than ever!

Get Ready to Roll Up Your Sleeves! Join Our Monthly Working Bee!

We're thrilled to invite you to our Monthly Working Bee on Saturday, November 2nd, at 9:00 AM at our beloved Clubhouse! This is a wonderful chance to lend a hand, meet fellow members, and help spruce up our Club!

Community Connections: Meet new friends and catch up with familiar faces while working together to enhance our space.
Sausage Sizzle Treat: Enjoy a delicious sausage sizzle on us as a reward for your hard work!
Make an Impact: Help create a vibrant atmosphere that showcases the heart and soul of our Club—together, we can put our clubhouse back on the map for food and entertainment!

Join Us Every Month! We're hosting a Working Bee on the first Saturday of each month at 9:00 AM, led by Fred Skerbič. Whether you're handy with tools or just want to pitch in, we have tasks for everyone!

RSVP Today! Reply to this email and let us know how many will join us. If you have special skills or trades, please share so we can assign you a fitting task!

Spread the Word! Feel free to share this invitation with friends and family. The more, the merrier—after all, many hands make light work!

Join us for a day filled with productivity, laughter, and community spirit. We can't wait to see you there, making new memories together!

Friday Nights & Sunday Afternoons: Your Club Awaits!

Join us for Friday nights at our Club, where we create a warm and inviting atmosphere for everyone! Starting at 5 PM, come enjoy a drink with friends and neighbors in a relaxed setting filled with laughter and camaraderie. It's the perfect way to unwind and connect with our community.

On Sunday afternoons, from 2–5 PM, the Club transforms into a cozy haven. Gather around the fireplace, enjoy the ambiance, and explore our Slovenian library, filled with books that celebrate our rich heritage. Spend your time in the clubhouse or soak up the sunshine in our beautiful garden beneath the grapevines. We're excited to offer card games that are quickly becoming a favorite, and we welcome your suggestions for other fun activities!

Don't miss out on our fantastic selection of Slovenian wines, beers, and schnapps. Whether you're here to socialize, play games, or simply enjoy a drink, we can't wait to welcome you! Come be a part of our vibrant community!

Grants Update: Exciting Developments Ahead!

We are thrilled to share that we are actively collaborating with the ACT Government to make the most of our remaining grant funds for our New Kitchen! Thanks to our successful applications for both the ACT Sustainable Grant and the ACT CCP Grant, we are now in the final stages of utilising these funds to bring your kitchen vision to life.

In this journey, we also want to honor and respect our elders who initiated this clubhouse, paving the way for our vibrant community. Their vision and hard work laid the foundation for everything we cherish today.

But that's not all! We are also submitting additional grant applications to further enhance our clubhouse, ensuring it remains a welcoming space for all members and guests. These initiatives are essential for fostering our vibrant community and preserving our Slovenian heritage.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue this exciting journey together! Your support and involvement make all the difference!

Members Library: Cozy Reading Awaits!

We are excited to announce the re-launch of our Members Library! This is a wonderful opportunity for our community to gather, relax by the fireside, and immerse themselves in a rich collection of Slovenian literature. Whether you're looking to explore our cultural heritage or simply enjoy a good read, we invite all members to come and make the most of this cozy space.

We also welcome and encourage members to contribute to our library! If you have Slovenian books you'd like to share, please feel free to drop them off at the club.

We've already received generous donations from fellow Slovenians who are downsizing, and we're eager to expand our collection even further.

Come join us at the library—where stories connect us, and the warmth of community comes alive!

Exciting News: Kitchen Upgrade Project Launching in November!

We're thrilled to announce that our highly anticipated Kitchen Upgrade Project is set to kick off in November! This exciting transformation will enhance our culinary space, allowing us to serve you even better at our events and gatherings. With modern facilities and improved functionality, our upgraded kitchen will not only support our delicious BBQs but also elevate the overall dining experience at the Club. We can't wait to share this journey with you as we bring your vision to life. Stay tuned for updates and thank you for your continued support in making our Club a vibrant community hub!

Clubhouse Maintenance: Exciting Updates Await!

We're excited to announce that our clubhouse is undergoing some fantastic touch-ups! Come by and experience the minor enhancements we've made to create a more inviting and secure space for everyone to enjoy.

We warmly invite you to visit the clubhouse and see the improvements for yourself! Your continued support is instrumental in helping us cultivate a space that truly reflects our lively community and rich Slovenian heritage.

Tune in for a Cultural Experience on Slovenian Radio!

Are you ready to immerse yourself in the heart of Slovenian culture? Tune in to Voice of Slovenian Australians 89.3, 2GL FM every Saturday from 10 AM to 12 PM for a lively Slovenian language radio program!

Whether you speak Slovenian or not, you're in for a treat! Enjoy captivating Slovenian news and let the enchanting melodies of our music transport you to the beautiful landscapes of Slovenia. This is not just a radio show; it's a celebration of our heritage and community!

Gather your family and friends, and let's come together through the power of music and storytelling. Don't miss this opportunity to connect with our roots and experience the warmth of our culture.

Mark your calendars and tune in—your Saturday mornings just got a lot more exciting!

Thanks and Appreciation: Together, We Thrive!

We want to take a moment to express our deepest gratitude for your unwavering support and dedication to our Club. Your enthusiasm and vibrant spirit are the heartbeat of our community, making it truly exceptional! We're excited to invite you to join us at the Club, where laughter, camaraderie, and our rich culture come together to create unforgettable memories.

Your generous contributions and active participation are crucial to our success. Together, we are building something remarkable—an enduring tribute to our heritage that strengthens the bonds among our members. Our progress would not be possible without our amazing members and devoted volunteers—thank you for being the foundation of our community!

As we continue to flourish, we're eager to keep you informed about our latest news and exciting developments. We encourage you to share your ideas, suggestions, and feedback; your voice is invaluable to our collective journey!

Let's keep this wonderful momentum going! Don't be a stranger—stop by, connect with fellow members, and immerse yourself in the lively spirit of our Club. We look forward to seeing you soon and creating cherished memories together!

Thank you for being an integral part of this incredible journey. Your commitment and involvement are what truly make our Club the heart of our community. Together, let's continue to cultivate a future filled with heritage, celebration, and lasting connections.

On behalf of the Committee,
Natasha Kapušin
President / Secretary
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Inc

Oktober je bil mesec izjemne energije in vznemirjenja v našem klubu! Ko smo pozdravili gladek prehod na nov odbor, smo ostali osredotočeni na naše tekoče projekte.

Ogromna zahvala našim predanim članom odbora in neprecenljivim prostovoljcem! Vaše neutrudno trdo delo in pozitivni duh vodita naš klub v živahno novo smer.

Obnova članstva!

Oktober je tukaj in čas je za obnovo članstev za 2024/2025! Pristojbine za pridruženo članstvo so $5 in za polno članstvo $10. Za nadgradnjo na polno članstvo je cena v prvem letu $302 z letno obnovitvijo $10.

Ugodnosti za člane: Zdravico za izključne privilegije!

Vznemirljive novosti za življenjske in polne člane! Zdaj uživajte v ekskluzivnih popustih pri kartonih Laško in Union piv!

Posodobitev parkirišča

Z veseljem naznanjamo, da bomo z 1. novembrom 2024 uvajali nov sistem upravljanja parkirišča.

Kultura in zabava: Čast slovenski tradiciji in dediščini

V našem klubu cenimo bogato tradicijo in dediščino slovenske skupnosti. Od živahnih druzenj do praznování kulturnih dogodkov vsaka priložnost odraža našo zavezanost ohranjanju navad.

Oktoberski dogodek: Praznovanje za zapomniti!

Nedelja, 13. oktober: Praznovali smo najstarejšo trto v Sloveniji — kos prestižne 400 let stare 'Stare trte' iz Maribora — skupaj z okusnm žarom!

Novembrski dogodek: Praznujte Sveti Martin Dan!

Nedelja, 10. november — Nazdravite Sveti Martin Dan s slovenskimi vini in kosilom ob žaru. Čas: 12:30. Cena: $25 člani · $30 nečlani · $12 otroci.

V imenu odbora,
Nataša Kapušin

December 2025

Dear Members,

We are excited to announce our new Committee for the 2025/2026 term.

We are pleased to share that we have retained the eight key committee members from the 2024/2025 term, ensuring continuity, stability, and the ability to carry forward the important work already underway. Alongside this, we warmly welcome three new, younger committee members in their 20s and 30s, who bring fresh perspectives, new ideas, and renewed energy to the team.

This strong combination of experience and youth places the club in a very positive position for the year ahead. Your committee is committed to building on recent achievements, listening to members, and continuing to create a welcoming, inclusive, and vibrant community for all.

Committee for 2025/2026

  • President: Natasha Kapusin
  • Vice President: Alojz Papez
  • Secretary: Natasha Kapusin

  • Treasurer: Josie Bresnik
  • Vice Treasurer: Crtomir Kores
  • Public Officer / Committee Member: Edward Hribar

Committee Members:

  • Fred Skerbic
  • Daryl Whitfeld
  • Blake Grmek
  • Stephanie Hall
  • Caitlin Kores

We look forward to another productive and exciting year ahead and thank you for your continued support of the club.

Warm regards,

Dragi člani,

Z veseljem naznanjamo naš novi odbor za mandatno obdobje 2025/2026.

Z veseljem sporočamo, da smo ohranili osem ključnih članov odbora iz mandata 2024/2025, kar zagotavlja kontinuiteto, stabilnost in zmožnost nadaljevanja pomembnega dela, ki je že v teku. Poleg tega toplo pozdravljamo tri nove, mlajše člane odbora v dvajsetih in tridesetih letih, ki prinašajo sveže perspektive, nove ideje in obnovljeno energijo ekipi.

Ta močna kombinacija izkušenj in mladosti postavlja klub v zelo pozitivno pozicijo za prihajajoče leto. Vaš odbor je zavzet za gradnjo na nedavnih dosežkih, poslušanje članov in nadaljevanje ustvarjanja gostoljubne, vključujoče in živahne skupnosti za vse.

Christmas & New Year MessageBožično in novoletno sporočilo

December 2025

We wish you a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year.

As we reflect on the past year, we are filled with gratitude for the ongoing support, energy, and community spirit shown by our members, families, friends, and supporters. Your involvement strengthens our connection to Slovenian heritage and keeps our community here in Canberra vibrant, welcoming, and inclusive — both through our Association and at the Slovenian Club Canberra.

Christmas is a time for togetherness, joy, and reflection. It is also a time to remember those who may be alone, far from family, or facing challenges. May we all reach out with kindness and compassion, bringing comfort, connection, and warmth to others during this special season.

Thank you for being part of our community. We look forward to continuing our journey together in the New Year. From everyone at the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, we wish you peace, good health, and every happiness in the year ahead.

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

On behalf of our Association,
Natasha Kapusin
President — Slovenian Australian Association Canberra

Želimo vam srečen Božič in srečno Novo leto.

Ko razmišljamo o preteklem letu, smo polni hvaležnosti za stalno podporo, energijo in skupnostni duh, ki so ga pokazali naši člani, družine, prijatelji in podporniki. Vaša vključenost krepi našo povezavo s slovensko dediščino in ohranja našo skupnost tukaj v Canberri živahno, gostoljubno in vključujočo — tako prek naše zveze kot v Slovenskem klubu Canberra.

Božič je čas skupnosti, veselja in razmisleka. Je tudi čas, da se spomnimo tistih, ki so morda sami, daleč od družine ali se soočajo z izzivi. Naj vsi rečemo roko s prijaznostjo in sočutjem ter prinesemo udobje, povezanost in toplino drugim v tej posebni sezoni.

Hvala, ker ste del naše skupnosti. Veselimo se nadaljevanja naše skupne poti v Novem letu. Od vseh pri Slovensko-avstralski zvezi Canberra vam želimo mir, dobro zdravje in vso srečo v letu pred nami.

Vesel Božič in srečno Novo leto!

V imenu naše zveze,
Natasha Kapusin
Predsednica — Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra

2026 Slovenian & Australian Cultural CalendarKulturni koledar 2026 — Slovenija in Avstralija

December 2025

Celebrate Life, Heritage & Community: Your 2026 Slovenian & Australian Cultural Calendar

Dear Valued Members and Friends,

Save the Date! The Committee is delighted to share our Slovenian & Australian Cultural Event Calendar for 2026. Please mark these important dates in your calendars and stay tuned for more details as each event approaches.

We're working on even more events and workshops behind the scenes, and we'll keep you updated as soon as each one is ready to share.

The Committee is proud to deliver a vibrant program that celebrates both our Slovenian heritage and our Australian home, bringing our community together in the spirit of connection we value so deeply.

Celebrate Life, Heritage & Community: Your 2026 Slovenian & Australian Cultural Calendar

  • January 26 – Australia Day
    A day to celebrate our shared Australian spirit, diversity, and community pride.
  • February 6–8 – Multicultural Festival at Garema Place, Canberra
    Experience the richness of Canberra's multicultural community, including Slovenian culture.
  • February 8 – Prešeren Day (National Day of Culture)
    Celebrating Slovenian culture and the national poet France Prešeren.
  • February 21 – Pust / Masquerade Dinner & Dance
    Chasing away winter with traditional Slovenian festivities.
  • March 6 – International Women's Day
    Honouring the achievements and contributions of women in our community.
  • March 22 – Slovenian Mother's Day High Tea
    A celebration of Slovenian mothers and their important role in our community.
  • March 22 – Easter Celebration Lunch
    Easter egg painting, butarice making, and potica tasting — bring a sweet Slovenian treat to share.
  • April 25 – ANZAC Day
    A solemn national day of remembrance honouring those who served and sacrificed for Australia and New Zealand.
  • April 25 – Chestnut Roasting and Mulled Wine
    A cosy celebration of autumn flavours and Slovenian tradition.
  • May 10 – Australian Mother's Day
    Recognising the love and strength of mothers and mother figures.
  • June 14 – Slovenian Father's Day Lunch
    Honouring Slovenian fathers and their role in our heritage and community.
  • June 20 – Statehood Day Celebration
    Celebrating Slovenia's statehood with dance, music, and community spirit.
  • September 6 – Slovenian National Costume and Heritage Day
    Showcasing traditional dress, folkloric dancing, and Slovenian cultural heritage.
  • September 6 – Australian Father's Day
    A day to celebrate all fathers and father figures in Australia.
  • September 26 – Stara Trta Working Bee
    A community working bee to transform the area around our Stara Trta. Honouring Slovenia's oldest vine and our own cutting grown from the 400+ year-old Stara Trta vine.
  • November 3 – Melbourne Cup Day
    A day to enjoy fashion, fun, and the thrill of the race that stops the nation.
  • November 7 – Sveti Martin Dan
    The official start of the wine season, celebrated across Slovenia.
  • November 23–25 – Honouring Slovenian Members Over 80
    Paying tribute to our cherished elder members and the legacy they built.
  • December 6 – Miklavževa (St. Nicholas Blessing)
    A festive celebration with a BBQ and St. Nicholas blessings.
  • December 26 – Slovenian Independence and Unity Day / Boxing Day BBQ
    Celebrating Slovenia's independence alongside a traditional Australian Boxing Day BBQ.
  • December 31 – New Year's Eve Dinner & Dance
    Ring in the new year with friends, music, and dance.

We look forward to celebrating a meaningful and vibrant year with our valued members and friends. Thank you for your ongoing support — we are excited to see our Clubhouse thriving once again!

On behalf of the Committee,
Natasha Kapusin
President
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Incorporated

Praznujmo življenje, dediščino in skupnost: Vaš kulturni koledar 2026

Dragi cenjeni člani in prijatelji,

Shranite datum! Odbor z veseljem deli naš kulturni program prireditev za 2026. Prosimo, zaznamujte te pomembne datume v svojih koledarjih in ostanite pozorni na več podrobnosti, ko se vsaka prireditev približa.

Za kulisami delamo na še več prireditvah in delavnicah ter vas bomo obveščali, ko bodo pripravljene za deljenje.

Odbor je ponosen na živahen program, ki praznuje tako slovensko dediščino kot naš avstralski dom, zbirajoč skupnost v duhu povezanosti, ki jo tako globoko cenimo.

Kulturni program 2026

  • 26. januar – Dan Avstralije
    Dan za praznovanje skupnega avstralskega duha, raznolikosti in skupnostnega ponosa.
  • 6.–8. februar – Multikulturni festival pri Garema Place, Canberra
    Doživite bogastvo multikulturne skupnosti Canberr, vključno s slovensko kulturo.
  • 8. februar – Prešernov dan (Narodni dan kulture)
    Praznovanje slovenske kulture in narodnega pesnika Franceta Prešerna.
  • 21. februar – Pust / Maskirna večerja in ples
    Odganjanje zime s tradicionalnimi slovenskimi veseljačenji.
  • 6. marec – Mednarodni dan žena
    Čaščenje dosežkov in prispevkov žensk v naši skupnosti.
  • 22. marec – Slovensko materinstvo — visoki čaj
    Praznovanje slovenskih mamic in njihove pomembne vloge v naši skupnosti.
  • 22. marec – Velikonočno praznično kosilo
    Barvanje pirhi, izdelovanje butaric in degustacija potice — prinesite sladko slovensko poslastico.
  • 25. april – Dan ANZAC
    Slovesen narodni dan spomina v čast tistim, ki so služili in žrtvovali za Avstralijo in Novo Zelandijo.
  • 25. april – Pečeni kostanij in kuhano vino
    Udobno praznovanje jesenskih okusov in slovenske tradicije.
  • 10. maj – Avstralski materinski dan
    Prepoznavanje ljubezni in moči mamic in materinskih figur.
  • 14. junij – Slovensko kosilo za dan očetov
    Čaščenje slovenskih očetov in njihove vloge v naši dediščini in skupnosti.
  • 20. junij – Praznovanje dneva državnosti
    Praznovanje slovenskega državnosti s plesom, glasbo in skupnostnim duhom.
  • 6. september – Dan slovenskega narodnega kostuma in dediščine
    Razkazovanje tradicionalnih noš, folklornih plesov in slovenske kulturne dediščine.
  • 6. september – Avstralski dan očetov
    Dan za praznovanje vseh očetov in očetovskih figur v Avstraliji.
  • 26. september – Delovna akcija pri Stari trti
    Skupnostna delovna akcija za ureditev prostora okoli naše Stare trte. Čaščenje najstarejše trte v Sloveniji in našega lastnega potaknjenca s 400+ let stare Stare Trte.
  • 3. november – Dan Melbournskega pokala
    Dan za uživanje mode, zabave in vznemirjenja dirke.
  • 7. november – Sveti Martin Dan
    Uradni začetek vinske sezone, ki se praznuje po vsej Sloveniji.
  • 23.–25. november – Čaščenje slovenskih članov nad 80 let
    Poklon dragim starejšim članom in zapuščini, ki so jo zgradili.
  • 6. december – Miklavževo (Blagoslov sv. Miklavža)
    Praznično praznovanje s piknik in blagoslovi sv. Miklavža.
  • 26. december – Dan slovenskega neodvisnosti in enotnosti / Piknik sv. Štefana
    Praznovanje slovenskega neodvisnosti skupaj s tradicionalnim avstralskim piknik.
  • 31. december – Novoletna večerja in ples
    Pričakajte novo leto s prijatelji, glasbo in plesom.

Veselimo se praznovanja smiselnega in živahnega leta z našimi cenjenimi člani in prijatelji. Hvala za vašo stalno podporo — navdušeni smo, da spet vidimo naš klub cveteti!

V imenu odbora,
Natasha Kapusin
Predsednica
Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra

Community Grape Harvesting Day – Volunteers NeededSkupnostni dan trgatve grozdja – Potrebujemo prostovoljce

March 2026

Join us this Sunday at the Slovenian Club for a wonderful community tradition as we harvest our grapes together.

At the Club we proudly grow two special varieties: the Stara Trta, originating from the famous over 400-year-old vine in Maribor, Slovenia, and the Red Isabella variety. This is a great opportunity to experience a small piece of Slovenian heritage right here in Canberra.

Event Details

  • 📅 Sunday 15 March
  • 🕙 From 11:00 AM
  • 📍 Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra — 19 Irving Street, Phillip ACT

Bring your family and friends and enjoy a morning of community spirit, fresh air, and tradition. We look forward to seeing many helping hands!

Pridružite se nam to nedeljo v Slovenskem klubu za čudovito skupnostno tradicijo, ko skupaj trgamo grozdje.

V klubu ponosno gojimo dve posebni sorti: Staro Trto, ki izvira iz slavne 400+ let stare trte v Mariboru, Slovenija, in sorto Rdeča Izabela. To je odlična priložnost, da doživite košček slovenske dediščine tukaj v Canberri.

Podrobnosti o prireditvi

  • 📅 Nedelja, 15. marec
  • 🕙 Od 11:00
  • 📍 Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra — 19 Irving Street, Phillip ACT

Prinesite družino in prijatelje ter uživajte v jutru skupnostnega duha, svežega zraka in tradicije. Veselimo se številnih pomočnikov!

Call for Volunteers: Multicultural Festival 2026 — Friday 6th – Sunday 8th February 2026Poziv prostovoljcem: Multikulturni festival 2026 — petek 6. – nedelja 8. februar 2026

January 2026

Dear Members and Friends,

We are pleased to announce that the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra will once again have a stand at the Multicultural Festival 2026, taking place on Friday 6 February, Saturday 7 February, and Sunday 8 February.

This is one of our biggest opportunities of the year to showcase our culture, food, drinks, and community. It is always a fun and rewarding weekend, and we cannot do it without the support of our volunteers.

We are inviting our Multicultural Superstars of 2025, as well as anyone keen to get involved including our interstate supporters, to join us for this fantastic event.

Parade Participation — Saturday 7 February 2026

The Multicultural Festival Parade will take place on Saturday 7 February 2026 between 3:00pm and 5:00pm, and we are looking for members and friends to proudly join us in the parade.

If you are travelling from interstate, please bring your Slovenian costume, as we have limited costumes available for loan.

Logistics and Set-Up Support

Friday 6 February 2026

  • Bump-in (set-up and decorating): 12:00pm – 4:00pm
  • Security (post set-up): 4:00pm – 5:00pm
  • Bump-out (alcohol stock overnight): 11:00pm – 12:00am

Saturday 7 February 2026

  • Bump-in (restocking): 6:00am – 9:00am
  • Security (post set-up): 9:00am – 10:00am
  • Bump-out (alcohol stock overnight): 11:00pm – 1:00am

Sunday 8 February 2026

  • Bump-in (restocking): 6:00am – 9:00am
  • Security (post set-up): 9:00am – 10:00am
  • Final bump-out (pack-down and return to the club): 5:00pm – 7:00pm

Staffing the Stand

We are looking for volunteers to assist with: serving food and drinks, engaging with the public, representing Slovenia with pride, assisting with general stand operations.

To express your interest in volunteering, please reply to this email or contact Natasha on 0401 219 330.

Warm regards,
Natasha Kapušin
President — Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

Z veseljem naznanjamo, da bo Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra znova imela stojnico na Multikulturnem festivalu 2026, ki bo potekal v petek 6. februarja, soboto 7. februarja in nedeljo 8. februarja.

To je ena naših največjih priložnosti v letu, da pokažemo svojo kulturo, hrano, pijačo in skupnost. Vedno je to zabaven in nagrajevalni vikend, ki ga ne moremo izpeljati brez podpore naših prostovoljcev.

Udeležba v paradi — sobota, 7. februar 2026

Parada Multikulturnega festivala bo potekala v soboto, 7. februarja 2026 med 15:00 in 17:00, in iščemo člane in prijatelje, ki bi se nam ponosno pridružili.

Če prihajate med zveznimi državami, prosimo prinesite slovensko narodno nošo, saj imamo na voljo omejeno število noš za izposojo.

Petek, 6. februar 2026

  • Postavitev (ureditev in okraševanje): 12:00 – 16:00

January 2026

Dear Members and Friends,

Happy New Year! We hope you had a wonderful start to 2026. Here's what's coming up at the club this month and beyond.

🍽️ Dober Tek Bistro — Now Open!

We're thrilled to share that our brand-new bistro, Dober Tek, is now open! Come and enjoy delicious food in a warm, community atmosphere. The bistro is open Wednesday through Sunday.

📅 Upcoming Events — January & February

  • Monday 26 January – Australia Day BBQ — Join us from 12:30pm for food, games and community fun.
  • Friday 6 – Sunday 8 February – Multicultural Festival — Find us at our stall at Garema Place.

Our Slovenian language classes are continuing this term. Check with us for current enrolment availability.

Pust (Carnivale) & Vinska Trgatev Dinner / Dance — Saturday 21st February 2026Pust (Carnivale) in Vinska Trgatev Večerja / Ples — sobota, 21. februar 2026

January 2026

Dear Members and Friends,

Get ready for one of the most exciting nights on our 2026 calendar — our Pust (Carnivale) & Vinska Trgatev Dinner and Dance!

Pust is the traditional Slovenian carnival — a vibrant, joyful celebration rooted in centuries of folklore. Come dressed in your most creative costume and enjoy a night of music, dancing, delicious food, and great company.

Event Details

  • 📅 Saturday, 21st February 2026
  • 🕕 6:00 PM
  • 📍 Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra — 19 Irving Street, Phillip ACT 2606

Pricing

  • Members: $70
  • Non-members: $75

Costumes encouraged — prizes for the best dressed!

Warm regards,
Natasha Kapušin
President — Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

Pripravite se na eno najvznemirljivejših noči v našem programu 2026 — naš Pust (Carnivale) in Vinska Trgatev Večerja in Ples!

Pust je tradicionalni slovenski karneval — živahno, veselo praznovanje, zakoreninjeno v stoletjih folklore. Prinesite se v najustvarjalnejšem kostumu in uživajte v noči glasbe, plesa, okusne hrane in prijetne druščine.

Podrobnosti o prireditvi

  • 📅 Sobota, 21. februar 2026
  • 🕕 18:00
  • 📍 Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra — 19 Irving Street, Phillip ACT 2606

Cene

  • Člani: $70
  • Nečlani: $75

Kostumi so dobrodošli — nagrade za najboljše oblečene!

Lep pozdrav,
Nataša Kapušin
Predsednica — Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra

Home / Newsletter / All Newsletters / April 2026

Easter Message — Slovenian Australian Association of CanberraVelikonočno sporočilo — Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra

April 2026

Dear Members and Friends,

On behalf of the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, we wish you and your families a joyful and blessed Easter — or as we say in Slovenian, Vesel Velikonočni praznik!

Easter is a time for renewal, hope, and togetherness — a time to reflect on the traditions that connect us across generations and across the world. Whether you are celebrating with family, attending church, or simply enjoying the long weekend, we hope it brings you peace and joy.

We are so grateful for our wonderful community here in Canberra. You make everything we do possible, and we look forward to many more shared celebrations and cultural milestones ahead.

Vesel Velika noč!

On behalf of the committee,
Natasha Kapušin
President — Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

V imenu Slovensko-avstralske zveze Canberra vam in vašim družinam želimo veselo in blagoslovljeno Veliko noč — ali kakor rečemo v slovenščini, Vesel Velikonočni praznik!

Velika noč je čas obnove, upanja in skupnosti — čas za razmislek o tradicijah, ki nas povezujejo čez generacije in po vsem svetu. Ne glede na to, ali praznujete z družino, greste k maši ali preprosto uživate v dolgem vikendu, upamo, da vam prinese mir in veselje.

Hvaležni smo za svojo čudovito skupnost tukaj v Canberri. Vi omogočate vse, kar počnemo, in veselimo se še številnih skupnih praznovanj in kulturnih mejnikov.

Vesel Velika noč!

V imenu odbora,
Nataša Kapušin
Predsednica — Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra

Slovenian Folk-Dance Workshop Series — 2 Cities | 2 Workshops | 1 Incredible Cultural ExperienceSerija delavnic slovenskega folklornega plesa — 2 mesti | 2 delavnici | 1 neverjeten kulturni doživljaj

April 2026

Dear Members and Friends,

We are thrilled to announce an extraordinary cultural experience — our Slovenian Folk-Dance Workshop Series! This is a unique opportunity to learn traditional Slovenian folk dance in two different Australian cities.

Workshop Details

  • 📍 Two locations across Australia
  • 🎭 Traditional Slovenian folk dance instruction
  • 🇸🇮 Open to all ages and experience levels
  • 📅 April 2026 — check with the club for exact dates

Whether you are a seasoned dancer or a complete beginner, this workshop is designed to be fun, accessible, and deeply connected to Slovenian cultural heritage.

To register your interest or find out more, please contact Natasha on 0401 219 330 or email secretary@slovenianclubcanberra.org.au.

Warm regards,
Natasha Kapušin
President — Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

Z navdušenjem naznanjamo izjemno kulturno izkušnjo — naša Serija delavnic slovenskega folklornega plesa! To je edinstvena priložnost za učenje tradicionalnega slovenskega folklornega plesa v dveh različnih avstralskih mestih.

Podrobnosti o delavnici

  • 📍 Dve lokaciji po Avstraliji
  • 🎭 Poučevanje tradicionalnega slovenskega folklornega plesa
  • 🇸🇮 Odprto za vse starosti in nivoje izkušenj
  • 📅 April 2026 — preverite z klubom za točne datume

Ne glede na to, ali ste izkušen plesalec ali popoln začetnik, je ta delavnica zasnovana tako, da je zabavna, dostopna in globoko povezana s slovensko kulturno dediščino.

Za registracijo zanimanja ali več informacij kontaktirajte Natašo na 0401 219 330 ali pišite na secretary@slovenianclubcanberra.org.au.

Lep pozdrav,
Nataša Kapušin

Introducing Naša Miza: The Slovenian Australian Cookbook — Your Family Recipe Could Be Published!Predstavljamo Naša Miza: Slovensko-avstralska kuharica — Vaš družinski recept bi lahko bil objavljen!

July 2026

Dear Members and Friends,

We are beyond excited to announce a truly special project — Naša Miza: The Slovenian Australian Cookbook!

This cookbook will be a celebration of the food, stories, and memories that define our Slovenian Australian community. We want to include recipes from our members — dishes passed down through generations, family favourites, and the food that reminds you of home, of Slovenia, of your parents and grandparents.

📖 How to Submit Your Recipe

  • Share a recipe that holds special meaning to your family
  • Include the story behind the dish — who taught you, where it comes from
  • Any Slovenian or Slovenian-inspired dish is welcome
  • Recipes can be in English or Slovenian

📬 How to Submit

  • 📧 Email: secretary@slovenianclubcanberra.org.au
  • 📞 Phone Natasha: 0401 219 330

This is your chance to leave a lasting legacy for future generations of Slovenian Australians. We cannot wait to see what you share with us!

Warm regards,
Natasha Kapušin
President — Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

Neizmerno smo navdušeni, da naznanjamo resnično poseben projekt — Naša Miza: Slovensko-avstralska kuharica!

Ta kuharica bo praznovanje hrane, zgodb in spominov, ki opredeljujejo naše slovensko-avstralsko skupnost. Želimo vključiti recepte naših članov — jedi, ki se prenašajo skozi generacije, družinski favoriti in hrana, ki vas spomni na dom, na Slovenijo, na vaše starše in stare starše.

📖 Kako oddati recept

  • Delite recept, ki ima posebnen pomen za vašo družino
  • Vključite zgodbo za jedjo — kdo vas je naučil, od kod izvira
  • Dobrodošla je katera koli slovenska ali slovensko navdahnjena jed
  • Recepti so lahko v angleščini ali slovenščini

📬 Kako oddati

  • 📧 E-pošta: secretary@slovenianclubcanberra.org.au
  • 📞 Pokličite Natašo: 0401 219 330

To je vaša priložnost, da zapustite trajno zapuščino za prihodnje generacije Slovencev v Avstraliji. Ne moremo se dočakati, kaj boste z nami delili!

Lep pozdrav,
Nataša Kapušin
Predsednica — Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra

Home / Local Tradies & Businesses

Supporting Our Community

Local tradies and businesses that make our club thrive

🛠️
Proudly Supporting Local Business
We celebrate the invaluable contributions of local tradespeople and businesses that support our community.

At the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, we celebrate the invaluable contributions of local tradespeople and businesses that support our community. This page is dedicated to showcasing the skilled professionals we rely on for various projects, including renovations, maintenance of our facilities, and events.

Our network includes a mix of paid services and dedicated volunteers, all of whom play a vital role in helping us maintain and enhance our club's environment. From electricians and plumbers to builders, caterers, IT professionals, butchers, bakers, and florists, these individuals bring expertise and commitment to every task, ensuring our space is welcoming and functional for all members and guests.

We encourage our community to support these local businesses, many of whom are fellow members or share our cultural heritage. By choosing to work with them, you not only benefit from their professional services but also contribute to strengthening our local economy and fostering connections within our community.

Thank you to all the tradies and businesses that stand with us! Your support makes a significant difference in our ability to celebrate and promote Slovenian culture in Canberra.

Home Events — 2026

2026 Events Calendar

Celebrate the best of Slovenian and Australian cultures — 21 events across the year

At the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, we believe in celebrating the rich tapestry of cultures that make up our community — every event is an immersive experience where traditions blend with modernity.

At the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, we believe in celebrating the rich tapestry of cultures that make up our community. Our events go beyond mere gatherings; they are immersive experiences where traditions seamlessly blend with modernity, bringing together both Slovenian and Australian heritage.

Join us for vibrant celebrations of Australian community culture and special events that showcase the beauty of Slovenian traditions throughout the year. Our gatherings on Friday evenings and Sunday afternoons provide fantastic opportunities to connect with fellow members, enjoy a variety of activities, and create lasting memories together!

If you're feeling shy about attending, we encourage you to check out photos from our past events on the Celebrating Our Journey page — they're a great way to see the fun and friendly atmosphere we cultivate. You'll want to be part of the excitement!

We also host kid-friendly activities at some functions, such as Easter egg painting and a special visit from Miklavz, making our events a fun experience for the whole family!

Whether you're looking to immerse yourself in Slovenian customs, participate in fun activities, or simply enjoy a great time with our welcoming community, we invite you to be part of our events. Every occasion is an opportunity to create lasting memories and strengthen the bonds that unite us all.

Connect & Celebrate! Check out our events calendar for a list of upcoming activities and special occasions. Keep an eye on our calendar for the latest updates and register to secure your spot. Follow us on social media for sneak peeks into our exciting activities. Come celebrate with us! Your presence enriches our community, and we can't wait to see you there!

Home / Events / Australia Day
Australian

Australia Day

📅 January 26, 2026  ·  Monday

Celebrate Australia's national day with a fun-filled BBQ! Join us for an afternoon of great food, music, and festivities as we honour Australia's unique spirit and culture. It's the perfect way to come together and make lasting memories with friends and family.

Expect live music, delicious food fresh off the grill, games for the kids, and the warm atmosphere that makes our club the heart of our community. Whether you've been coming for years or it's your first time, you are always welcome here.

Interested in attending?

Contact us to register your interest or find out more about this event.

Home / Events / Multicultural Festival at Garema Place
Voluntary

Multicultural Festival at Garema Place

📅 February 6–8, 2026  ·  Friday–Sunday

Join us at the vibrant Multicultural Festival at Garema Place, where the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra proudly celebrates cultural diversity! This is a voluntary event where our members have the opportunity to represent Slovenian culture at one of Canberra's most beloved annual festivals.

Our stall showcases traditional Slovenian food including the famous Kranjski Roll with Sauerkraut, costumes, music, and crafts — an incredible opportunity to share our heritage with thousands of festival-goers.

Interested in attending?

Contact us to register your interest or find out more about this event.

Home / Events / Prešeren Day — National Day of Culture
Cultural

Prešeren Day — National Day of Culture

📅 February 8, 2026  ·  Sunday

On February 8th, Slovenia celebrates its National Day of Culture — Prešeren Day — named in honour of France Prešeren, Slovenia's greatest poet and a central figure of Slovenian national identity.

Join us as we honour this special day with poetry readings, cultural presentations, and a celebration of Slovenia's rich artistic and literary heritage. This event is held in conjunction with the Multicultural Festival at Garema Place.

Interested in attending?

Contact us to register your interest or find out more about this event.

Home / Events / Pust / Masquerade Dinner & Dance
Signature Event

Pust / Masquerade Dinner & Dance

📅 February 21, 2026  ·  Saturday

Get ready for one of the most anticipated nights on our calendar! Pust is the traditional Slovenian carnival — a vibrant, joyful celebration rooted in centuries of folklore and tradition. The highlight is the traditional Kurent — Slovenia's iconic carnival figure who chases away winter.

Our Masquerade Dinner & Dance promises to be a night full of laughter, surprises, and incredible energy. Come dressed in your most creative costume — there will be prizes for the best dressed! Enjoy a delicious dinner, live music, and dancing that goes well into the night.

Costumes are encouraged — the more creative, the better!

Interested in attending?

Contact us to register your interest or find out more about this event.

Community

International Women's Day

📅 March 6, 2026  ·  Friday

Come celebrate the incredible women who make our community strong! At the Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra, we take this opportunity to honour the strength, resilience, and contributions of the women in our club — past and present.

Join us for an evening of heartfelt speeches, shared stories, and celebration of the remarkable women in our community. All are welcome.

Special Occasion

Slovenian Mother's Day High Tea

📅 March 22, 2026  ·  Sunday

Treat the amazing women in your life to a beautiful Slovenian Mother's Day High Tea. In Slovenia, Mother's Day is celebrated in March — and we honour this tradition with warmth, elegance, and togetherness.

Our High Tea features beautiful table settings, a selection of Slovenian and Australian treats, and a relaxed, elegant atmosphere. Places are limited — book early to secure your table.

Interested in attending?

Family Event

Easter Celebration Lunch

Home / Events / Stara Trta Working BeeDelovna akcija pri Stari trti
Unique Event

Stara Trta Working BeeDelovna akcija pri Stari trti

📅 September 26, 2026  ·  Saturday  ·  9:00am – 3:00pm26. september 2026  ·  sobota  ·  9:00–15:00

Dear Members and Friends,

🍇🇸🇮 Let’s make our Stara Trta shine! 🇸🇮🍇

Our Stara Trta — the Old Vine of Slovenia — is more than just a grapevine. It is a living connection to Slovenian heritage, tradition and generations of our community.

Now, we want to give it the setting it deserves.

STARA TRTA WORKING BEE

📅 Saturday 26 September 2026
⏰ 9:00am – 3:00pm
📍 Slovenian Club Canberra

We are bringing our community together to preserve, enhance and transform the area around our Stara Trta into a beautiful centrepiece of our club — a place where members and visitors can gather, admire the vine and celebrate our Slovenian heritage.

We would love you to come along and lend a hand. Whether you can stay for the whole day or just pop in for a few hours, every helping hand makes a difference.

🌿 Help us bring the area to life
🤝 Enjoy some time with fellow members
🥨 Snacks provided
🍷 Wine provided

Most importantly, let’s enjoy the day together and celebrate this very special part of our Slovenian heritage.

Our vine. Our heritage. Our community.

We look forward to seeing you there and creating something special around our Stara Trta that our whole community can enjoy for years to come.

On behalf of the Committee,

Natasha Kapušin
President
Slovenian Australian Association of Canberra Incorporated

Dragi člani in prijatelji,

🍇🇸🇮 Naredimo našo Staro trto sijajno! 🇸🇮🍇

Naša Stara trta — stara trta Slovenije — je več kot le vinska trta. Je živa vez s slovensko dediščino, izročilom in rodovi naše skupnosti.

Zdaj ji želimo dati okolje, ki si ga zasluži.

DELOVNA AKCIJA PRI STARI TRTI

📅 Sobota, 26. september 2026
⏰ 9:00–15:00
📍 Slovenski klub Canberra

Združujemo našo skupnost, da bi ohranili, izboljšali in preoblikovali prostor okoli naše Stare trte v čudovito središče našega kluba — prostor, kjer se lahko člani in obiskovalci zberejo, občudujejo trto in praznujejo našo slovensko dediščino.

Vabljeni, da pridete in priskočite na pomoč. Ne glede na to, ali lahko ostanete ves dan ali se oglasite le za nekaj ur, vsaka pomoč šteje.

🌿 Pomagajte nam obuditi prostor
🤝 Preživite čas z drugimi člani
🥨 Prigrizki preskrbljeni
🍷 Vino preskrbljeno

Najpomembneje pa je, da uživamo v dnevu skupaj in praznujemo ta res poseben del naše slovenske dediščine.

Naša trta. Naša dediščina. Naša skupnost.

Veselimo se vas in ustvarjanja nečesa posebnega okoli naše Stare trte, v čemer bo lahko uživala vsa naša skupnost še dolga leta.

V imenu odbora,

Natasha Kapušin
Predsednica
Slovensko-avstralska zveza Canberra (Inc.)

Miklavž at the Slovenian Club CanberraMiklavž v Slovenskem klubu Canberra

📅 Sunday 6 December 2026  ·  Doors open 12pm📅 Nedelja, 6. december 2026  ·  vrata odprta ob 12. uri

✨ A Magical Slovenian Christmas Tradition

🚪12:00pmDoors open
🎅2:30pmMiklavž arrives
🏠3:30pmGingerbread House Decorating

Experience the joy and magic of Miklavževa and share one of Slovenia’s most treasured traditions with the whole family.

In Slovenian tradition, St. Nicholas (Miklavž) visits children around 6 December, bringing small gifts and reminding us of the true spirit of giving, kindness and generosity.

🎅 Miklavž Is Coming!

Miklavž will make a special visit to the Club, with blessings and gifts for the children.

🎁 Parents: Please bring a small wrapped gift for your child, clearly labelled with their name, to be presented by Miklavž.
The Slovenian Club Canberra will also provide a small gift for each child.

🍪 Gingerbread House Decorating

At 3:30pm, it’s time to get creative! Design your very own Slovenian-inspired gingerbread house and help us build our little Slovenian village right here at the Club.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Children & adults welcome
  • 🏡 Create your own Slovenian-inspired house
  • 🏆 Best Gingerbread House wins a prize — Child and Adult prizes!
  • 🎀 Take your gingerbread house home with you, beautifully wrapped and ready to enjoy!
  • 💲 Small participation fee — TBC

🔥 Food & Festive Fun

  • 🍖 BBQ
  • 🎄 Festive food
  • 🇸🇮 Slovenian traditions
  • 🎅 Miklavž & gifts
  • 🍪 Gingerbread house decorating
  • ❤️ Family, friends & community

🎉 All Ages Welcome!

Bring the whole family and experience the magic of Miklavževa — a beautiful Slovenian tradition we can share across generations. Come celebrate, create and make memories with us.

Sunday 6 December 2026
Doors open 12pm  ·  Miklavž — 2:30pm  ·  Gingerbread House Decorating — 3:30pm
Na Miklavža! 🎅

✨ Čarobna slovenska božična tradicija

🚪12.00Odprtje vrat
🎅14.30Prihod Miklavža
🏠15.30Okraševanje medenjaških hišic

Doživite veselje in čarobnost Miklavževega in z vso družino delite eno najdragocenejših slovenskih tradicij.

Po slovenski tradiciji sv. Miklavž okoli 6. decembra obišče otroke, jim prinese majhna darila in nas opomni na pravi duh dajanja, prijaznosti in radodarnosti.

🎅 Miklavž prihaja!

Miklavž bo posebej obiskal naš klub ter otrokom prinesel blagoslov in darila.

🎁 Starši: prosimo, prinesite majhno zavito darilo za svojega otroka, jasno označeno z njegovim imenom, ki mu ga bo izročil Miklavž.
Slovenski klub Canberra bo prav tako pripravil majhno darilo za vsakega otroka.

🍪 Okraševanje medenjaških hišic

Ob 15.30 je čas za ustvarjanje! Oblikujte svojo medenjaško hišico v slovenskem slogu in nam pomagajte zgraditi malo slovensko vas kar v klubu.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Dobrodošli otroci in odrasli
  • 🏡 Ustvarite svojo hišico v slovenskem slogu
  • 🏆 Najlepša medenjaška hišica prejme nagrado — nagrada za otroke in za odrasle!
  • 🎀 Hišico odnesete domov, lepo zavito in pripravljeno za uživanje!
  • 💲 Manjša prijavnina — bo objavljena naknadno

🔥 Hrana in praznična zabava

  • 🍖 Piknik (BBQ)
  • 🎄 Praznična hrana
  • 🇸🇮 Slovenske tradicije
  • 🎅 Miklavž in darila
  • 🍪 Okraševanje medenjaških hišic
  • ❤️ Družina, prijatelji in skupnost

🎉 Dobrodošli vsi, ne glede na starost!

Pripeljite vso družino in doživite čarobnost Miklavževega — lepe slovenske tradicije, ki jo lahko delimo med generacijami. Pridite praznovat, ustvarjat in nabirat lepe spomine z nami.

Nedelja, 6. december 2026
Vrata odprta ob 12. uri  ·  Miklavž — 14.30  ·  Okraševanje medenjaških hišic — 15.30
Na Miklavža! 🎅

Slovenia Meets AustraliaSlovenija sreča Avstralijo

📅 Saturday 26 December 2026  ·  Independence & Unity Day × Boxing Day📅 Sobota, 26. december 2026  ·  dan samostojnosti in enotnosti × Boxing Day

Two traditions. Two homes. One big celebration. 🇸🇮🇦🇺

Celebrate Slovenia’s Independence and Unity Day alongside the relaxed spirit of an Australian Boxing Day — right here at your Club.

Christmas Day has been eaten. Now it’s time to relax! 😄

🕧 Club opens · 12:30pm🔥 BBQ · from 1:30pm💲 BBQ price · TBC

Come along for a relaxed summer afternoon filled with good food, great company, Slovenian spirit and Australian fun.

From Slovenia to Australia — let’s celebrate together.
Dobrodošli! 🎉
Everyone is welcome.

Why 26 December? On 26 December 1990, Slovenians voted in a plebiscite for independence, which led to the declaration of independence in June 1991.

Dve tradiciji. Dva domova. Eno veliko praznovanje. 🇸🇮🇦🇺

Praznujte slovenski dan samostojnosti in enotnosti skupaj s sproščenim duhom avstralskega Boxing Daya — kar v vašem klubu.

Božično kosilo je pojedeno. Zdaj je čas za sprostitev! 😄

🕧 Klub odprt · 12.30🔥 Piknik · od 13.30💲 Cena piknika · bo objavljena

  • 🥃 Slovenske pijače
  • 🎶 Glasba in poletno vzdušje
  • 🎯 Igre in zabava na vrtu
  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Družina • prijatelji • skupnost

Pridite na sproščeno poletno popoldne, polno dobre hrane, odlične družbe, slovenskega duha in avstralske zabave.

Od Slovenije do Avstralije — praznujmo skupaj.
Dobrodošli! 🎉
Vsi ste vabljeni.

Zakaj 26. december? 26. decembra 1990 so Slovenci na plebiscitu glasovali za samostojnost, kar je vodilo do razglasitve neodvisnosti junija 1991.
